title: Part-Time Content Strategist & Social Media Manager – Wellness & Lifestyle Personal Brand
description:
About the Role

I'm looking for a highly creative, proactive and social-media-obsessed Content Strategist & Social Media Manager to help me build a successful wellness and lifestyle personal brand in the US. My Account: sveniacastillo



My vision is to become one of the most recognizable wellness and lifestyle influencers in Los Angeles.



Think: The ultimate Pilates, wellness, beauty and lifestyle girl.



I want to create an aspirational yet authentic personal brand around wellness, beauty, everyday lifestyle and enjoying life.



My content will revolve around:



Pilates, movement and daily wellness routines

Skincare, beauty and self-care

Matcha, coffee runs and healthy habits

Morning routines, walks and slow living

Healthy recipes (approximately 1–2 times per week)

Being self-employed and building a business

Marriage, relationships and everyday life

Life between Los Angeles and Las Vegas

Creating beautiful moments and enjoying life

The overall aesthetic should feel feminine, effortless, clean, aspirational, natural and relatable.



I want people to genuinely enjoy following my everyday life and feel inspired by the lifestyle I share.



Content Inspiration

Some creators whose content style I 
 – I love her natural storytelling, beautiful everyday content, food aesthetics and the way she makes ordinary moments interesting. I don't want to focus heavily on cooking, but I love her overall creative style.

Melissa Wood – Wellness, Pilates and feminine lifestyle.

Remi Ishizuka – Personal branding, lifestyle and storytelling.

Other successful US-based wellness, beauty and lifestyle creators.

These are inspirations, not templates. I want to develop my own recognizable style and personal brand.



I am also very open to your creative input, recommendations and new inspiration. I want someone who can bring fresh ideas and help shape the overall direction of the account.



What I'm Looking For

I need someone who genuinely LOVES social media.



Someone who is naturally chronically online because they enjoy following creators, discovering new trends, watching Reels and TikToks and understanding what's happening in the US social media world.



You should be someone who:



Knows the latest Instagram and TikTok trends in the US.

Recognizes viral formats before they become oversaturated.

Understands what makes people stop scrolling.

Has a strong creative eye for aesthetic lifestyle content.

Knows how to turn everyday moments into engaging content.

Constantly comes up with new ideas and creative concepts.

Understands the US influencer landscape, especially wellness, beauty and lifestyle.

I don't want someone who simply follows instructions. I want someone who thinks like a content creator and strategist, takes initiative and genuinely wants to grow the account.



Being chronically online and always see the latest trends is a plus - because you love and live social media 



Your Responsibilities

1. Content Strategy & Planning

Develop weekly and monthly content calendars.

Create content ideas tailored to my personality, lifestyle, niche and visual identity.

Research current US trends, viral formats, sounds and hooks.

Suggest what I should film and how to film it.

Develop engaging video concepts and storytelling ideas.

Write video hooks and voice-over scripts when needed.

Identify opportunities to create viral and highly shareable content.

Continuously develop and improve the overall content strategy.

2. Video Editing & Creative Direction

Take over the entire video editing process.

Edit Instagram Reels and TikToks using the raw footage I provide.

Add hooks, subtitles, text overlays, transitions and music.

Use trending sounds and editing styles where appropriate.

Create beautiful, engaging and natural-looking videos.

Maintain a consistent aesthetic and recognizable editing style.

Suggest creative filming ideas and additional footage when needed.

I want content that feels effortless, aesthetic and authentic – not overly edited or forced.



3. Social Media Management & Publishing

Prepare engaging captions.

Schedule and publish all content.

Post approximately 2 times per day, 5–7 days per week.

Optimize content for Instagram and TikTok.

Monitor account performance, reach and engagement.

Analyze which formats and topics perform best.

Continuously adjust the strategy to support account growth.

How We Will Work Together

I want to focus almost exclusively on filming content and living the lifestyle I want to share.



I will:



Film videos and take pictures throughout my everyday life.

Upload all raw footage to a shared Google Drive.

Record voice-overs whenever needed.

Be available for creative discussions and feedback.

Film specific clips when you suggest ideas that require additional footage.

You will take over everything else:



Content planning and strategy

Trend research

Creative concepts

Video editing

Voice-over integration

Captions and hooks

Scheduling and publishing

Performance analysis

I am happy to record voice-overs and provide additional creative input. You can suggest scripts, talking points and ideas for videos that would benefit from my voice.



In the beginning, we will communicate closely to establish my personal style, visual identity, editing preferences and overall brand direction.



Once we have found our rhythm, I want you to take ownership of the content process and work independently.



I want this to feel like a creative partnership.



Working Hours & Expectations

This is a PART-TIME position, NOT a full-time job.



The expected workload is approximately 2–3 hours per day maximum.



I'm looking for someone efficient, organized and creative who can manage their time well.



You do not need to be available 24/7.



Consistency, creativity and quality of work matter much more than hours spent online.



The goal is to create an efficient workflow that allows us to consistently publish approximately 2 posts per day, 5–7 days per week.



Requirements

Excellent knowledge of Instagram and TikTok.

Strong understanding of current US social media trends.

Experience with short-form video editing (CapCut or similar).

Experience in content strategy and social media management.

Excellent English writing skills.

Strong creative and aesthetic sense.

Understanding of storytelling and personal branding.

Highly organized, reliable and proactive.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

A portfolio of previous work is required.

Experience in wellness, beauty, Pilates, food or lifestyle content is a huge plus.



Bonus Points

You naturally follow US wellness and lifestyle influencers.

You know what's currently trending in Los Angeles and the US.

You have experience growing personal brands from scratch.

You understand how to turn everyday moments into engaging Reels.

You have experience with aesthetic lifestyle, food and wellness content.

You have a strong understanding of what makes people follow and connect with an influencer.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



Your portfolio and examples of Instagram or TikTok accounts you have managed.

Examples of Reels or TikToks you have edited.

Your favorite US wellness, beauty and lifestyle creators.

Why do you think certain lifestyle influencers become successful?

If you were building my account from scratch, what would your first 5 content ideas be?

What is your expected monthly rate for a 2–3 hour per day position?

Important: Please don't send a generic application. I want to see your creativity, personality and understanding of social media.



I'm looking for someone who is genuinely excited about building a personal brand and wants to grow alongside it long-term.



If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you!

title: Real Estate Cold Caller and Appointment Setter (Full Time, US Hours)
description:
About the role



About the role



You will work directly with a US-based real estate professional who lists properties for sale and also buys properties for cash. Your job is to contact property owners by phone and
, find out whether they are interested in selling, and book an appointment for interested owners. You will not negotiate prices or make offers. The owner of the business handles that.

Send introduction and follow-up
s to the same contacts

Follow up consistently with owners who say “not now” or “maybe later”

Log every call and
, and keep contact records accurate and up to date

Clear, natural spoken English and strong written English

Friendly and patient with homeowners, and comfortable handling rejection

Organized and consistent with follow-ups and notes

Available to work US Pacific business hours (night shift in the Philippines)

Quiet workspace, reliable internet with backup, and a good headset



How to apply



Put “Real Estate Caller” plus your first name in the subject line.

Send a 1 to 2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your cold calling experience. Applications without a recording will not be reviewed.

Tell us your expected hourly rate and when you can start.

Accounts. Set up and maintain profiles on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Keep bios, links, and highlights updated and aligned with our brand.

Weekly report. Posts published, reach and engagement, ad results, and what you recommend changing.

title: Part-Time QA Tester (Web + iPhone + Android) for Home Staging Software. Record Your Sessions
description:
StageEngine is software that runs home staging companies: their furniture inventory, jobs, proposals, contracts, invoices and payments. We're a small US company in California. We need a careful manual tester who enjoys trying to break things, every week, on a real iPhone, a real Android phone and a computer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Every week we put a new version of the app on our test site. Within 48 hours, work through that week's checklist (usually 30-80 checks) and mark each one pass, fail or blocked.

- Then use the app the way a staging company's office manager would (quote a job, send a contract, bill a client, check furniture in and out) and find where it breaks or where a real user would get stuck.

- Write clear bug reports: the steps, what you expected, what happened, the device, and the time in your recording.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 1 year of manual testing on web or mobile apps. SaaS is a plus; billing, invoicing or payment apps are a big plus.

- A working iPhone AND an Android phone of your own, plus a computer.

- Clear written English.

- You're comfortable recording your screen and talking through what you're doing. EVERY session is recorded, with your voice. This is required, and it's paid time.

- About 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday. Some overlap with US Pacific mornings (your late evening) is a plus.



PAY

- $550 a month base for about 20 hours a week.

- Plus a bonus for each confirmed bug that our own automated (AI) testing missed: $10 for a serious bug, $3 for a small one, up to $150 a month.

- Paid twice a month. It starts with a paid 2-hour trial on the real app.



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any of these are skipped)

1. Put the word SANDPIPER in the first line of your application.

2. Tell us which iPhone model and which Android phone you own.

3. Include a link to a 1-2 minute screen recording (Loom or Google Drive) of you testing the sign-up page of any website, talking through what you check and what you would report.

title: Short-Form Video Research Assistant (TikTok & Instagram)
description:
We’re looking for a Short-Form Video Research Assistant for a one-week paid project, with the possibility of ongoing work.



Your main responsibility will be finding high-performing street interviews, street-interview ads, product reactions and public challenge videos across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



For each suitable video, you’ll add the following information to a structured Google Sheet:



• Original video link

• Platform and account name

• Visible views, likes, comments and shares

• Complete video transcript

• Opening hook

• Questions and follow-up questions

• Overall format and structure

• Product introduction, if applicable

• Strongest reaction or moment

• CTA or ending

• Presenter and editing style

• What makes the video effective

• How the format could be adapted for another product or brand

• Useful audience comments where relevant



You’ll be provided with clear instructions, completed examples, dropdown labels and a tracking template.



The ideal candidate:



• Understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and short-form content

• Has strong written English

• Is comfortable using Google Sheets and Google Drive

• Can follow detailed instructions accurately

• Has excellent attention to detail

• Can identify strong hooks, questions and storytelling

• Is comfortable using AI transcription tools

• Can work independently and check for duplicate videos



PAYMENT



• $160 fixed payment for the completed 40-hour week

• Additional $20 quality bonus available



The $20 quality bonus will be paid if:



• At least 150 suitable videos are properly tracked

• At least 90% of audited information is accurate

• Records are complete, organised and free from unnecessary duplicates

• Transcripts, hooks, questions and product introductions are correctly identified

• The completed spreadsheet and files are delivered by the agreed deadline



HOURS



• 40 hours across five days

• Eight hours per day

• Working hours can be flexible



WEEKLY TARGETS



• Minimum: 120 properly tracked videos

• Target: 150 properly tracked videos

• Stretch: 200 videos if accuracy remains high



Quality and accuracy are more important than reaching the stretch target. Incomplete, duplicated or inaccurately labelled records will not count towards the total.



This will begin as a one-week project. If your work is accurate, organised and thoughtful, there may be ongoing weekly or part-time work available.



TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Any relevant research, data-entry or social-media experience

3. Confirmation that you can complete 40 hours for $160

4. One street-interview video you think is creatively strong

5. Two or three sentences explaining why the video works



Begin your application with “VIDEO RESEARCH” so we know you have read the full description.

title: Operations Manager (Growth & Training Role)
description:
Operations Manager (Growth & Training Role)

Chickadee Cleans, LLC | Remote | Full-Time | Arizona Hours



First, Let's Talk About What This Role Is NOT



We're a small, growing company looking for someone who wants to take ownership of their work, solve problems independently, and help us build better systems as we grow.



**This is NOT the right position for you if:**



- You need constant direction or micromanagement.

We provide SOPs, resources, and support, but expect you to take initiative, learn independently, and figure things out without step-by-step instructions for every situation.



- You prefer being given a daily task list. 

This isn't a position where you wait to be told what to do next. You'll need to identify priorities, anticipate needs, and take responsibility for getting things done.



- You need extensive training or hand-holding.

We're happy to answer questions and provide guidance, but expect you to read, understand, and apply our SOPs, learn new systems independently, and be resourceful.



- You struggle with fast-paced or unpredictable environments. 

We work in short-term rental cleaning, where last-minute reservations, scheduling changes, callouts, and unexpected issues are part of daily operations.



- You need a flexible work schedule or frequently miss shifts. 

Our clients and field teams depend on consistent communication and coverage. This is a scheduled position, and reliable attendance and punctuality are essential.



- You wait for someone else to solve problems. 

We're looking for someone who takes action, follows through, and communicates proactively rather than passing problems along.



- You're uncomfortable making decisions or handling difficult conversations.

You'll be the primary point of contact for clients, cleaners, and runners, and eventually responsible for making most day-to-day operational decisions independently.



**What you CAN expect from us:**



We're not micromanagers. We believe in giving capable people the tools, trust, and autonomy to do their jobs well.



You'll have access to documented procedures, established systems, and a small, supportive admin team. We're available to answer questions, but we expect you to take ownership of your responsibilities, speak up when you need help, and suggest improvements when you see a better way.



We don't expect perfection or for you to know everything immediately. We do expect accountability, good judgment, follow-through, and a willingness to continuously learn.



We value people who pay attention to the little things. As one small example, please include the word "sunflower" in your subject line when applying. We believe great operations come down to consistency, communication, and attention to detail.



If you're dependable, resourceful, proactive, and enjoy keeping a busy operation running smoothly without someone looking over your shoulder, we'd love to hear from you.



>> About Chickadee Cleans



Chickadee Cleans is a growing short-term rental cleaning company serving the greater Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona areas.



We specialize in cleaning and preparing vacation rentals between guest stays, working closely with property managers, homeowners, and cleaning teams to ensure every property is guest-ready.



We're a small company with big growth plans, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



>> About the Role



We're hiring an Operations Manager in training who will eventually take full ownership of our day-to-day operations.



You'll begin by learning our systems, procedures, clients, and team while managing daily communication and scheduling. As you demonstrate competency, reliability, and sound judgment, you'll progressively take on greater responsibility and decision-making authority.



Our goal is for you to independently run daily operations with minimal oversight or approval.



This isn't simply an administrative position. We're looking for someone who can grow into a leadership role, improve processes, make decisions, and take responsibility for operational results.



>> Key Responsibilities



Daily Operations & Scheduling

- Manage cleaning schedules, assignments, and last-minute changes.

- Coordinate cleaners, runners, and inspections to ensure jobs are completed on time.

- Handle callouts, schedule conflicts, and unexpected operational challenges.

- Monitor active jobs and proactively identify potential problems.

- Ensure reservations, job details, and operational records are accurate and up to date.



Client & Team Communication

- Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, cleaners, and runners.

- Manage the operations inbox and respond professionally and promptly.

- Communicate schedule changes, expectations, and important updates.

- Resolve routine questions, concerns, and operational issues independently.

- Escalate significant issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of their resolution.



Quality Control & Accountability

- Monitor cleaning completion, inspections, and quality concerns.

- Coordinate corrections and follow-up when necessary.

- Help ensure team members follow company procedures and expectations.

- Identify recurring problems and implement solutions.



Recruiting, Hiring & Team Development

- Proactively recruit, screen, and interview new cleaners and runners.

- Maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates to support staffing needs and company growth.

- Coordinate onboarding, training, and performance evaluations for new team members.

- Identify staffing gaps and take initiative to address them before they impact operations.



Process Improvement & Leadership

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, communication, and workflows.

- Maintain, update, and improve SOPs as processes evolve.

- Take initiative on projects and operational improvements without waiting for assignments.

- Gradually assume greater responsibility for team performance, staffing needs, and operational decision-making.



>> Your Growth Path



We're looking for a long-term team member who wants increasing responsibility, independence, and compensation.



1. First 30 Days — Communication Ownership



Learn our systems, clients, and procedures while taking ownership of the operations inbox and routine communication.



Goal: Independently manage daily communication with minimal assistance.



2. By 90 Days — Independent Operations



Take responsibility for daily scheduling, assignments, problem-solving, and operational coordination.



Goal: Competently manage routine operations without daily supervision.



3. By 6 Months — Operations Management



Transition into broader responsibility for recruiting, hiring, team accountability, process improvements, performance, and operational decisions.



Goal: Independently oversee daily operations, escalating only exceptional or high-impact decisions. Maintain adequate staffing, and proactively recruit and onboard new team members with minimal owner involvement.



*These are performance-based targets, not automatic promotions. Progression depends on demonstrated competency, judgment, initiative, reliability, and consistency.



>> Qualifications



Required:

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

- Dependable attendance and punctuality.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable learning software and following written SOPs.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

- Confidence communicating with clients and team members.

- Comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for outcomes.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and suitable remote workspace.



Preferred:

- Experience in operations, scheduling, dispatch, hospitality, or property management.

- Familiarity with short-term rentals or cleaning operations.

title: Book Editor and Fact-Checker for a Warm, Practical Self-Help Book (American English, About 45,000 Words)
description:
This book is a practical guide, the voice is warm and honest, like one friend talking to another. Short sentences. Specific details. A little humor.

The full first draft is written. We need a careful, skilled editor to check everything and make it read beautifully, without losing the human voice.



What you'll do

Read the full draft and the style guide, then build a style sheet (spellings, terms, numbers, capitalization, recurring Spanish words).

Check the structure. Every stage follows the same fixed template, and the action always comes before the explanation. You check all 33.

Check fixed terms. Seven terms must be used exactly the same way every time (for example, "stage," never "lesson").

Fact-check. Verify every research claim and number against a reliable source. Anything you can't verify goes in the fact-check log. You never fix a fact by guessing.

Flag unsourced stories and quotes. Every pilgrim story needs a source note. If one is missing, flag it. Don't remove it or rewrite it.

Line edit. Cut filler, tighten long sentences, remove banned words from our list, keep each stage within 600 to 800 words.

Copyedit. Grammar, punctuation, American spelling, consistency.

Log your reasons. Use tracked changes. Put any change to meaning or voice in a comment, as a suggestion. Don't make it silently.

Do a second pass after the author reviews your edits.

The most important rule



Protect the voice. This book is meant to sound like a real person, not a perfect one. Some short fragments, some plain words, and some slightly imperfect rhythm are on purpose. Your job is to make it clearer and cleaner, not smoother or more formal. When in doubt, leave it and add a comment.



You must have

Excellent written English, with a natural feel for casual, conversational American English.

At least 3 full-length books edited (nonfiction preferred: self-help, wellbeing, memoir, or practical guides). Please share titles or samples.

Experience with tracked changes in Word or Google Docs, and with style sheets.

A careful fact-checking habit. You know the difference between "verified," "plausible," and "not found."

Reliable communication: a short written update twice a week, and replies within 24 hours on workdays.

At least 4 hours of overlap with [YOUR TIME ZONE] on two or three days a week, for questions.

Nice to have

You know The Chicago Manual of Style.

You've edited books with a fixed repeating structure (workbooks, devotionals, 30-day programs).

You've traveled, hiked, or done a long walk, or know what the Camino de Santiago is.

Some familiarity with Spanish words.

Deliverables

Edited manuscript with tracked changes and comments.

A clean copy with all changes accepted.

Style sheet.

Fact-check log: each claim, its source, and a status (verified, needs source, could not verify).

Flag report: unsourced stories or quotes, stages over or under word count, template breaks, banned words found.

Query log: every question for the author, in one list.

Terms

Fixed price, paid in four milestones after a paid test.

Confidential. You'll sign an NDA. All rights stay with the author.

AI tools: please tell us honestly whether and how you use them. Grammar checkers are fine. Running the manuscript through AI rewriting tools is not allowed. The voice must stay human.

title: Ecommerce Finance Manager (CPA preferred) | QuickBooks, Shopify, Inventory | Part-time
description:
ABOUT US

Furry Muse designs fashion-first, performance-built pet accessories: harnesses, walkwear, leashes, collars and 18K gold-plated jewelry. Since the viral Wander! Bow Harness, we've built a loyal community of pet parents and been featured in BuzzFeed, Modern Luxury, ABC7NY and Yahoo. We sell on Shopify, TikTok Shop and Faire, with Chewy coming soon. Founder-led and fully remote: our founder is in Singapore, our small team is global.



THE ROLE

Part-time finance manager to own our numbers: sit above our external bookkeeper, keep management reporting tied to the books, and coordinate Singapore and US tax filings with our advisers.

- Phase 1: 4-6 week project to fix our reporting, about 60-80 hours (12-15 hrs/week)

- Phase 2: ongoing retainer, about 15-25 hours a month, offered to the same person once Phase 1 is accepted



PHASE 1 DELIVERABLES

- Map our Google Sheets management report to QuickBooks accounts and reconcile year to date (variances over 1-2% explained)

- Reconcile Shopify, TikTok Shop and Faire payouts into QuickBooks (A2X or similar)

- Value US, China and in-transit inventory on a documented landed-cost method (incl. duties), tied to the balance sheet

- Reconcile intercompany balances between our Singapore parent and US LLC

- Set the month-end close calendar with the bookkeeper; build the monthly P&L pack and run one live close

- Build a rolling 13-week cash forecast

- Prepare data packs and a filing calendar for our tax advisers (they file)

- Document everything

Accepted when the year-to-date report ties to QuickBooks within 1-2% and one live close is delivered on time.



PHASE 2

Review the bookkeeper's work, produce the monthly P&L pack, keep reporting tied to the books, check inventory/COGS, update the cash forecast, prepare payments for our approval, track tax deadlines, and review monthly with our CFO and founder. Not included: signing tax filings, releasing payments, annual budgeting.



REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years in finance/accounting, ideally DTC or ecommerce

- Hands-on QuickBooks Online and Shopify/marketplace payout reconciliation

- Multi-location inventory accounting (landed cost, goods in transit)

- Multi-entity, multi-currency and intercompany experience

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel; has built a management report or cash forecast

- Clear written English; overlap with Singapore hours (UTC+8)

- CPA strongly preferred; non-CPAs with clear ecommerce and inventory experience considered

- Nice to have: US sales tax or Singapore compliance, ShipHero, Airwallex, Mercury

No Singapore or US tax expertise needed.



HOW WE WORK

- Independent contractor, remote, Philippines-based

- Reports to our part-time CFO (an investor), working with the founder; weekly check-in in Phase 1, monthly after

- Tools: Slack, QuickBooks, Shopify, ShipHero, Google Drive

- View-only bank access; no payment release; NDA required

- Rate: US$12-20/hour, hours capped and agreed in writing

- Shortlisted candidates do a paid 2-3 hour trial task



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with MARKETPLACE. Then answer:

1. How would you reconcile Shopify, TikTok Shop and Faire payouts in QuickBooks?

2. How would you value stock held in China, in transit and in a US warehouse, including duties?

3. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and are you a CPA?

Include a link to your CV or profile. Applications that skip the questions won't be reviewed.

title: Client Account Manager – Accounting & Advisory (AI-Augmented US Firm)
description:
💰 Compensation Structure & Multi-Level Earning Potential

Compensation is paid monthly via fixed, predictable retainers per assigned client ledger. We do not pay by the hour; we reward efficiency, data integrity, and tech-forward automation.

Our firm features a structured, 5-Tier Compensation Framework. You will begin with our active Level 1 and Level 2 accounts. As the firm scales and you prove your mastery of our workflows, you have the direct potential to be assigned to higher-paying, complex portfolios:



• Level 1 — $50 USD per client/month (Micro-Accounts)

Low-volume, straightforward bookkeeping with limited active accounts, low transaction volume, and minimal reconciliation complexity.

	• Benchmark: Simple Short-term rental / Airbnb-type engagement.



• Level 2 — $100 USD per client/month (Standard Business Accounts)

Moderate recurring bookkeeping workload. Features multiple active accounts, active credit cards/merchant processors, Profit First allocation accounts, light payroll-related bookkeeping, and moderate Balance Sheet activity.

	• Benchmarks: Standard local service provider, beauty/wellness business, or accounting/tax firm internal books.



• Level 3 — $175 USD per client/month (Advanced Business Accounts)

Materially higher recurring bookkeeping workload. Features numerous active accounts, higher transaction volume, meaningful payroll-related bookkeeping, multiple owners/shareholders, active A/R or A/P, and greater reconciliation/close requirements.

	• Benchmark: Construction, commercial property management, or mid-sized service providers with substantial operational accounting complexity.



• Level 4 — $250 USD per client/month (High-Volume / Multi-Entity Portfolios)

Highly complex bookkeeping involving multiple businesses or entities within a single client relationship. Features separate books across separate entities, high aggregate transaction volume, intercompany transfers, significant fixed assets, and extensive Month-End, Quarter-End, and Year-End requirements.

	• Benchmark: Multi-business, multi-entity client relationships generating $450,000–$500,000+ in revenue requiring collective bookkeeping across separate business entities (e.g., a single owner running a handyman service, a roofing company, and a holding group simultaneously).



• Level 5 — $350 – $500 USD per client/month (Premium / Advisory-Integrated Portfolio)

Premium engagement involving substantial bookkeeping complexity PLUS specifically authorized, expanded financial-analysis, financial-management recommendations, independent professional judgment, and client-facing financial-review responsibilities.

	• Requirement: Requires specific PFT authorization and demonstrated competency. Actual compensation within the $350–$500 range depends entirely upon the actual assigned scope.



About Our Firm

Profit First Taxes is a modern, high-efficiency United States-based tax and accounting firm led by an Enrolled Agent (EA). We operate primarily on US Eastern Time. Our firm leverages cutting-edge technology and QuickBooks AI to eliminate 80% of traditional manual data entry.

We serve a stable, highly automated portfolio of clients, including real estate/Airbnb investors, e-commerce brands, and local businesses, alongside our own corporate books. We do not hire traditional data-entry clerks who simply want to click buttons. We hire articulate, analytical, and autonomous Account Managers who act as the pilots of our automation, protect our data hygiene, and help deliver high-level financial insights to our clients.



Position Overview

You will manage a select portfolio of US-based business accounts under the direct mentorship of an Enrolled Agent. Because our software handles the routine data matching, your value lies in your critical thinking, data auditing, and professional communication. You must be completely comfortable working independently, taking initiative when the firm owner is unavailable, and communicating directly with clients.



Core Responsibilities & Strict Deadlines

• Supervise the Automation: Review and approve automated QuickBooks AI transaction classifications weekly. Proactively maintain tight bank rules to keep matching accuracy above 85%.

• Reconciliations & Diagnostics: Perform complete month-end reconciliations for bank accounts, credit cards, and specialized e-commerce/merchant platforms.

• The 10th-of-the-Month Closeout Rule: All assigned accounts must be fully closed and reconciled within 10 days of month-end. You are required to submit a mandatory 5-to-10 minute screen-share video (using Loom) by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the 10th of every month showing successful reconciliation screens.

• The 14th Correction Deadline: PFT reviews all submissions between the 11th and 13th. All corrections must be fully completed and resubmitted by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the 14th to satisfy the completion standard for that month's compensation cycle.

• AI-Driven Advisory Prep: Extract quarterly financial statements, leverage advanced LLMs (ChatGPT or Gemini) to investigate variances, and refine the output into a professional executive summary.

• Direct Client Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for your assigned accounts. Independently schedule short appointments with clients via the firm's calendar to go over their monthly or quarterly books and answer questions.



Mandatory Performance & Contract Terms

1. Flat-Rate, All-Inclusive Structure: The monthly flat retainer per account is fully inclusive of all operational tasks, including transaction checking, reconciliations, client scheduling, async Loom video updates, and necessary internal review meetings. No additional hourly billing or meeting fees are permitted.

2. Review-Ready Standard: Marking an account as "Review-Ready" means all bank rules are verified, miscellaneous/suspense accounts are completely cleared, and the ledger is ready for the EA's final sign-off without routine cleanup.

3. No Automatic Tenure Increases: Length of service does not grant automatic raises. Compensation scaling is strictly tied to your willingness to assume advanced advisory tasks (like budgeting) and your demonstrated accuracy.



Required Qualifications

• Tax & Accounting Firm Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of direct experience working inside a US-based CPA firm, tax firm, or accounting practice. You must thoroughly understand the connection between daily bookkeeping entries and clean, tax-ready financial statements.

• E-Commerce & Real Estate Fluency: Proven experience managing books for US small businesses, S-Corps, real estate/Airbnb operations, Service based businesses and Shopify environments.

• Degree in Accounting: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is strictly required.

• Tech-Forward Mindset: Highly proficient with QuickBooks Online, advanced bank rules, and utilizing ChatGPT or Gemini for financial analysis documentation.

• Excellent Spoken English: Completely confident and articulate when speaking directly with US business owners over video calls.

• BIG PLUS – Tax Preparation Experience: Candidates who have verified experience preparing US federal tax returns (Form 1040, 1120S, or 1065) will be heavily prioritized. While this is primarily an Account Manager position, an opportunity exists for a high-paying dual role where you can take on separate tax preparation workloads during the busy US tax season.



⚠️ MANDATORY APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, you must reply with the exact subject line: "Ready to Pilot the Automation for PFT".

Your application message must include a link or file for a 3-to-5 minute screen-share video recording addressing the two practical scenarios below.

Note: You are entirely free to use any video recording software or sharing platform of your choice (Loom, Zoom recording, Vidyard, an unlisted YouTube video, or a cloud drive link like Google Drive/Dropbox). Loom is welcome but not mandatory. You do not need—and should not use—a live QuickBooks account for this demonstration. You are entirely free to use any creative presentation method you prefer (such as opening a blank spreadsheet, typing into a notepad document, or prompting live inside ChatGPT/Gemini on screen) to verbally explain and demonstrate your problem-solving process. We want to see how you process information, think critically, and communicate financial concepts on your feet.



Scenario A: The Shopify Payout Discrepancy

• The Situation: A client’s bank feed shows a clean net deposit from Shopify for $4,500. However, the Shopify store backend shows that gross sales for that exact period were actually $5,000, with $300 in merchant fees and $200 in sales tax collected.



• Your Task: Share your screen and verbally walk us through the step-by-step accounting logic of how you would handle and process this situation so the final business financials remain 100% tax-ready and accurate.



Scenario B: The AI Financial Analysis

• The Situation: A client’s Profit & Loss statement shows that "Advertising Expenses" suddenly spiked from $1,200 last month to $4,800 this month, while their gross revenue only increased by 5%.



• Your Task: Share your screen and demonstrate or explain how you would leverage an advanced Large Language Model (like ChatGPT or Gemini) to investigate this variance and prepare a concise, high-level, 3-bullet-point executive summary for the firm owner.



Applications that fail to use the correct subject line or fail to provide the open-ended Loom video link will be automatically archived without review.

title: Credentialing Coordinator (US Payer Enrollment, Eastern Hours)
description:
ABOUT US



WoundGen is a US mobile regenerative wound care company. We provide physician-led wound care to Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial patients in multiple states, including skilled nursing facilities, long-term care, assisted living, and home health. We are hiring a full-time independent contractor to manage provider credentialing and payer enrollment.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Credentialing Coordinator prepares, submits, and follows up on provider enrollment and re-credentialing with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial payers. You will keep CAQH and PECOS profiles current, track every application to a decision, and log every follow-up with a date, representative name, and reference number. This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. You will report to the Credentialing lead.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare, submit, and track initial enrollment, re-credentialing, and demographic updates with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial payers

- Maintain accurate provider profiles in CAQH, PECOS, and payer portals

- Follow up on pending applications until they are approved, denied, or clearly blocked, and log each follow-up the same day (date, payer, representative, and reference number)

- Monitor licenses, certifications, and other documents that affect enrollment, and flag upcoming expirations

- Keep a complete, current credentialing tracker (status, effective dates, next follow-up, and source of each update)

- Coordinate with billing, eligibility, and clinical staff when a payer enrollment issue is holding claims

- Escalate stalled or high-risk items quickly, with proof, rather than leaving them untouched

- Do not submit, restart, or change an application that is on hold without written company approval

- Keep records for each billing entity strictly separate from any other entity

- Follow HIPAA and company privacy rules at all times



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of US provider credentialing or payer enrollment experience

- Hands-on experience with PECOS and CAQH

- Experience enrolling providers with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial payers

- Experience using payer portals and following up by phone and

- Strong written and spoken English

- Stable internet and a quiet, private workspace

- Able to work full-time, Monday through Friday, during US Eastern business hours

, local drives, or unapproved cloud storage. Work is done only in company systems over a company VPN or VDI.

- Experience tracking retro effective-date or enrollment-gap requests

Full-time, Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours. This is a remote contractor role.



PAY

title: Credit Repair Dispute Specialist (FCRA, Credit Repair Cloud), Remote
description:
Boost1 Enterprises is hiring a Dispute Specialist (Credit Repair).



About Boost1 Enterprises



Boost1 Enterprises helps US clients fix their credit. We challenge inaccurate, unverifiable, or outdated items on credit reports, and we serve adults 18 and older in the United States. Our line is "Fix your credit. Unlock your lifestyle." Learn more at 
.



This is process-driven work. We do not promise specific results or score changes.



The Role



You will own our dispute and letter work. You review credit reports, identify items that qualify for dispute, draft FCRA-based letters, and send them once our founder approves them, following our SOPs. This is a remote role. It does not include sales, lead follow-up, billing, or intake calls, and it is not a general virtual assistant position.



Responsibilities



- Review credit reports and identify items that are inaccurate, unverifiable, or outdated.

- Dispute qualifying items, including collections, charge-offs, late payments, hard inquiries, medical items, liens, judgments, repossessions, foreclosures, and bankruptcies.

- Draft bureau dispute letters to Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion, round by round, and send each round once it's approved.

- Track 30-day bureau response deadlines and escalate to the next round (including certified mail) when a bureau doesn't respond.

- Draft creditor and furnisher letters, cease-and-desist letters, goodwill letters, and CFPB complaints when the file calls for them.

- Log every letter and action in Credit Repair Cloud the same day, and post round updates in our team Discord.



Requirements



- Hands-on experience with US credit repair and FCRA-based disputes.

- Experience with Credit Repair Cloud or a similar credit repair CRM.

- Strong written English.

- High attention to detail and same-day logging.

- Able to keep client information confidential.

- Your own computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work.



Preferred skills



- Experience sending letters through Credit Repair Cloud mail.

- Experience with CFPB complaints, cease-and-desist letters, and goodwill letters.

- CreditHeroScore experience.

- Comfort using Discord.



Tools



- Credit Repair Cloud: CRM, letters, mailing, and client portal

- CreditHeroScore: credit reports and monitoring

- Discord: team chat and client files

- WhatsApp: quick team messages only, never client data

- Notion: internal SOPs



Schedule



- Remote and flexible. Volume starts smaller and grows as we add clients.

- Most work is asynchronous in Credit Repair Cloud and Discord. You need to be reachable and able to meet 30-day bureau deadlines.

- Some overlap with US Eastern time is a plus.



Pay



- $4 to $6 USD per hour, based on experience and accuracy, paid weekly.

- Performance bonuses for accuracy and on-time work, details shared at hire.

- Hours are tracked and logged daily, and every letter and action must be logged in Credit Repair Cloud the same day.

- Letters with errors or ineligible items must be redone.

- Pay is reviewed as volume grows.

title: Senior SEO Specialist – Australian Education Company (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About us:



We are an established Australian education company with over 15 years of experience helping students achieve academic success.



We have a strong online presence, an established brand, and an ambitious growth strategy. We are currently investing in a new, faster, modern website and want an experienced SEO professional to take full ownership of our organic search performance.



This is an opportunity to join a growing international company, work directly with our management team, and have a meaningful impact on the business.



About the Role:



We are looking for a highly experienced SEO specialist who can independently manage and execute our entire SEO strategy.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are not looking for someone who has completed a short SEO course or has a basic understanding of search engine optimisation.



We want someone with at least 5 years of hands-on SEO experience, a proven track record of improving organic rankings and traffic, and an excellent understanding of how SEO is evolving with AI-powered search.



You will be responsible for both developing the strategy and executing it.



Key Responsibilities:



SEO Strategy & Technical Optimisation



- Take ownership of our overall SEO strategy and organic growth.



- Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.



- Analyse website architecture, internal linking, crawlability, indexing, redirects, and structured data.



- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.



- Optimise existing pages and identify opportunities for new high-performing landing pages.



- Work closely with our web developer and designer to implement technical and on-page improvements.



- Monitor algorithm updates and adapt our strategy accordingly.



Link Building & Outreach



- Develop and execute a high-quality backlink acquisition strategy.



- Identify and secure relevant backlinks from genuine, authoritative Australian websites.



- Conduct outreach to Australian education websites, parenting blogs, publications, schools, and other relevant organisations.



- Build relationships that create ongoing link-building opportunities.



- Audit existing backlinks and identify opportunities and risks.



- Focus on sustainable, white-hat link building — no spam, link farms, or PBNs.



Analytics & Performance



- Expertly use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Ahrefs (or similar).



- Monitor rankings, impressions, CTR, organic traffic, and conversions.



- Investigate ranking declines and identify actionable solutions.



- Produce clear, actionable performance reports.



- Identify opportunities based on data rather than assumptions.



- Track the impact of SEO activities and demonstrate measurable results.



AI Search Optimisation (AEO / GEO)



- Develop strategies to improve our visibility in AI-powered search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.



- Understand Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).



- Implement content and technical improvements to increase our visibility in AI-generated answers.



- Stay informed about developments in AI search and emerging best practices.





Requirements



Essential:



Minimum 5 years of professional, hands-on SEO experience.



Proven track record of achieving meaningful improvements in organic rankings, traffic, and conversions.



Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Ahrefs.



Strong technical SEO knowledge, including indexing, crawling, redirects, structured data, and site architecture.



Demonstrated experience acquiring high-quality, relevant backlinks through genuine outreach.



Experience with Australian, UK, or US websites and competitive English-language search markets.



Up-to-date knowledge of AI search and modern SEO strategies.



Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and take ownership of results.



Strong written English and communication skills.



Comfortable collaborating with developers and designers.



Highly Desirable:



Experience working on large websites with thousands of pages.



Experience with local SEO and location-based landing pages.



Familiarity with modern website frameworks, including Astro or other JavaScript-based websites.



Experience recovering websites from ranking declines or managing major website migrations.



Previous experience in the education industry.





What We Offer



Long-term, stable, full-time remote employment.



Opportunity to work with an established Australian company.



Direct access to management and the ability to influence business strategy.



Access to professional SEO tools and support from our development and design teams.



Freedom to recommend and implement strategies rather than simply following instructions.



Salary negotiable based on your experience, capabilities, and results.



Opportunities for salary growth as you demonstrate value.





How to Apply



We are only interested in applicants who can demonstrate real SEO expertise.



Please include the following in your application:



Your SEO experience: How many years have you worked professionally in SEO, and what types of websites have you managed?



Proof of results: Provide at least two case studies demonstrating improvements you personally achieved in organic traffic, rankings, or conversions. Screenshots from Google Search Console or Ahrefs are strongly preferred.



Link-building experience: Explain how you acquire high-quality backlinks, particularly from Australian websites. Include examples of links you have successfully secured.



AI search knowledge: Explain what you are currently doing to optimise websites for AI-powered search engines.



Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.



Please be specific about the work you personally performed and the measurable results you achieved.



Applications without relevant examples of previous SEO work will not be considered.



We are looking for someone exceptional who wants to grow with our company over the long term.

title: TikTok Shop Growth Manager for Seasonal Product — Amazon MCF, Creator Content
description:
We are an established novelty and gag-gift brand looking for an experienced TikTok Shop Manager to grow our TikTok Shop sales during November and December.



Our products are highly visual, unusual and designed to generate immediate reactions. They are natural scroll-stoppers, well suited to entertaining short-form content and frequently purchased on impulse. A previous TikTok account manager described our brand as “perfect for the TikTok Shop platform.”



Our previous TikTok success



Our products already have a proven history on TikTok. Affiliates—including creators without large followings—have generated millions of views, with successful videos producing thousands of product sales per day.



TikTok activity has also created a significant halo effect across Amazon and our other sales channels. However, our objective is to make TikTok Shop independently profitable rather than relying on sales generated elsewhere.



Our TikTok Shop performance has not yet been stable or consistent. November and December are our most important months, and we want to give the channel a focused push with an experienced operator.

Our hero products each sell approximately 20,000 units on Amazon during December without relying on TikTok. With the right TikTok Shop strategy, creator programme and content volume, we believe there is a substantial opportunity to generate incremental sales directly through TikTok Shop.



This is an ambitious growth project, and we are looking for someone who can create a practical, commercially sound plan—not simply promise viral results.



What we need



TikTok Shop management

* Build and execute a focused November–December growth plan.

* Get 200 affiliate product videos ASAP

* Integrate MCF so Amazon can fulfil order

* Optimise our hero-product listings, pricing, promotions, vouchers and offers.

* Monitor shop health, policy compliance, fulfilment performance and customer experience.

* Provide clear weekly reporting covering GMV, orders, creator activity, advertising and profitability.



Amazon MCF integration

We currently hold inventory with Amazon and want TikTok Shop orders fulfilled through Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment.

The successful candidate should be able to:

* Configure and test Amazon MCF for TikTok Shop.

* Map products, SKUs, inventory and orders correctly.

* Ensure tracking information flows back to TikTok Shop correctly.

* Configure an appropriate return process.

* Troubleshoot fulfilment, inventory or tracking problems.

* Recommend the best integration based on our existing systems.



We currently use Helium 10 and ShipStation. I believe Helium 10 already has a MCF integration tool. Please explain whether either platform can support the proposed workflow or whether you recommend a different integration.



At this stage, we are hesitant to send substantial inventory to Fulfilled by TikTok because the channel has not yet proven itself for us.



Creator and affiliate programme

Our initial target is to generate at least 200 product videos from relevant TikTok creators and affiliates.

Responsibilities will include:

* Identifying and recruiting suitable creators.

* Managing targeted and open affiliate collaborations.

* Coordinating product samples.

* Following up with creators who receive products.

* Creating briefs with strong hooks, demonstrations and content angles. We already know what works and have a proven script.

* Developing appropriate commission and incentive structures.

* Tracking samples, posting rates, videos, views, sales and creator-attributed GMV.

* Identifying successful creators and encouraging them to produce additional content.



Creators do not need large followings. We care more about entertaining content, product fit, consistency and sales performance.

An existing network or warm list of relevant US TikTok creators would be a significant advantage. Please describe the size and relevance of your current creator network, but do not claim access to creators you have not personally worked with.



Content and advertising

Depending on your experience, the role may also include:

* Creating TikTok-native videos for our brand account.

* Coordinating video production with creators or editors.

* Developing funny, reaction-led and gifting-focused content concepts.

* Posting and managing content on our TikTok account.

* Identifying winning affiliate content for amplification.

* Managing TikTok Shop Ads, Spark Ads or GMV Max campaigns.

* Monitoring advertising performance and contribution margin.

Please be clear about which of these activities you personally perform and which would require additional creators, editors or media buyers.

However getting Creators to create 200 videos of our product would be a more important priority.



Required qualifications

* Demonstrable hands-on experience managing TikTok Shop for physical-product brands.

* Previous experience with TikTok Shop affiliates and creator outreach.

* Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, FBA (desired) and MCF.

* Strong understanding of TikTok Shop fulfilment and tracking requirements.

* Experience reading and acting on TikTok Shop performance data.

* Ability to work independently and move quickly during a seasonal campaign.

* Clear written and spoken English.

* Availability to begin immediately and remain actively engaged throughout November and December.



Particularly valuable experience

* Novelty products, gag gifts, unusual gifts or impulse-purchase products.

* Seasonal gifting campaigns.

* Comedy, reaction or entertainment-led content.

* An understanding of US and UK humour, language and cultural references.

* An existing network of TikTok Shop creators.

* TikTok Shop UK management.

* GMV Max, Spark Ads or TikTok Shop Ads.

* Scaling a hero product through affiliate content.



Please include the following in your application

1. Evidence from TikTok Shops you have personally managed.

2. Results you personally helped generate, including GMV, orders and affiliate performance. Please send links to viral videos and store sales that are publicly available, so we can verify for ourselves.

3. Your exact responsibilities on each account.

4. The Amazon MCF integrations you have personally configured.

5. Your proposed plan for the first 7, 30 and 60 days.

6. How you would generate 200 product videos during the project.

7. The number of creators you would expect to contact, sample and activate.

8. Your previous sample-to-post rate, if available.

9. Whether you personally create videos or coordinate creators and editors.

10. Your experience with TikTok Shop Ads, Spark Ads or GMV Max.

11. Your availability, location, time zone and expected weekly hours.

12. Your proposed fixed price or hourly rate for the two-month engagement.

Please begin your application with the words “Novelty TikTok Shop” so we know you have read the complete description.



Please let us know if you are an official TikTok Shop partnered agency (desired).

s, social media outreach and in-person visits.

title: Instagram DM Appointment Setter
description:
About us

I’m Shane, and I run Shane Warne Fitness. I’m a chronic pain specialist helping people aged 30 to 55, mostly in the US and Australia, get out of pain and move freely again. My main offer is Pain to Freedom, a high-ticket, 12-week program that’s fully personalised to each client. Almost all of my business starts in Instagram DMs, so this role sits right at the heart of it.



The role

You’ll be the first person our leads talk to. Most of them have been in pain for years and feel let down by the usual treatments, so the job is real conversation, not pushy sales. You will:



- Reply to Instagram DMs through ManyChat, following our scripts

- Reach out to new followers and start conversations

- Ask good questions to understand each person’s pain and situation

- Invite the right people to book a free Pain to Freedom Assessment Call

- Keep our tracking sheet up to date (who you spoke to and who booked)

- Flag anything sensitive or unusual to me

- You won’t be selling the program. Your job is to build trust and book the call, and I handle the rest.



Most of the time you’ll be messaging as me. I’m Australian, so I’m looking for someone who can sound like me: warm, casual, down-to-earth and honest, like texting a friend, not a salesperson.



You’ll be handling people’s private health information, so discretion is a must.



What you need

- Excellent written English that sounds natural, not robotic

- Experience in DM setting, chat support or appointment setting (fitness or health is a bonus)

- Comfortable with Instagram and Google Sheets (ManyChat experience is a big plus)

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Genuine empathy, because you’ll be talking to people who are hurting



Nice to have: reels editing

It’s a bonus if you can also edit simple Instagram Reels in CapCut or Instagram’s own editor: cutting clips, adding captions and text, and basic music. Nothing advanced, so no DaVinci or Premiere needed. It won’t be a big part of the role at first, but it could be added later.



Hours

Part-time, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday, as a split shift:

2pm to 4pm Philippine time

8pm to 10pm Philippine time



Fast replies matter in this role, so during your shifts you’ll need to keep an eye on the inbox and reply to new messages quickly. There’s room to grow as the role develops.



Pay

US$520 to $650 per month, depending on experience. It’s a fixed monthly salary, paid weekly to start. The role begins with a 2-week paid trial, and pay is reviewed after 90 days. Once you’re confident running conversations through to booked calls, there’s scope for performance bonuses, plus extra pay for reels work if we add it.



How to apply

1: Start your application with the word “Freedom” so I know you read this. Applications without it won’t be considered.

2: Tell me briefly about your DM or setting experience.

3: Tell me whether you can work the hours above, and whether you currently work for other clients.

4: Reply to these three DMs as if you were working for me:

DM 1: “I’ve had lower back pain for about 3 years, physio hasn’t really helped”

DM 2: Someone has just followed us, and we sent them this message:

 Us: “Hey, thanks for the follow! Was it the hips causing back pain reel that caught your eye?”

 Them: “Yes”

 Write our next message.

DM 3: “I’ve been dealing with the pain for about 15 years, but I’ve been ignoring it most of that time. I’ve just started looking for a fix.”

5: Let me know if you’ve edited Reels before in CapCut or Instagram’s editor. A sentence or two is plenty.

title: Shopify Customer Support & Chargeback Specialist
description:
SHOPIFY CUSTOMER SUPPORT & CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST

FIRST EMPLOYEE | CAREER GROWTH | PERFORMANCE BONUSES | LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY



I am an ambitious e-commerce entrepreneur running multiple international Shopify stores, and I am looking for my very FIRST employee.



This is not just another Virtual Assistant job.



I am looking for someone who wants to become an important part of my business, grow alongside me, and potentially develop into a leadership or management position in the coming years.



As my first employee, you will have a unique opportunity to help build the foundation of my e-commerce business and become one of the most trusted and important members of my future team.



WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT?



- You will be my very first employee and work directly with me.

- You will have a key position in my business from day one.

- You can earn additional bonuses for successfully won chargeback disputes.

- You can earn performance-based bonuses for consistently excellent work.

- You will have opportunities for salary increases as you develop.

- You may grow into senior, team leader, or management positions.

- You will have the opportunity to help train and manage future employees.

- You will be involved in improving processes and building the business.

- I am looking for a long-term partnership, not a temporary employee.



My goal is to build a successful international e-commerce business over the next several years, and I want to find someone who is genuinely excited to be part of that journey.



I believe that people who contribute to the success of a business should also have opportunities to benefit from its growth.



I value honesty, reliability, initiative, hard work, and mutual respect.



----------------------------------------



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CUSTOMER SUPPORT



- Independently manage customer support for multiple Shopify stores.

- Respond professionally to customer
s.

- Handle tracking inquiries, shipping delays, returns, refunds, cancellations, and complaints.

- Communicate with suppliers when necessary.

- Follow my store policies and customer service guidelines.

- Assist customers in different languages using translation tools.

- Maintain fast response times and excellent customer satisfaction.

- Help improve customer support processes and overall efficiency.

- Take responsibility for providing consistent, high-quality customer service.



2. CHARGEBACKS AND PAYMENT DISPUTES



- Independently manage Shopify Payments chargebacks.

- Collect and organize tracking details, delivery confirmations, order information, and customer communications.

- Prepare accurate, professional, detailed, and convincing dispute responses.

- Submit evidence before all deadlines.

- Monitor open disputes and track results.

- Help prevent unnecessary chargebacks.

- Maintain organized records of disputes and outcomes.

- Provide regular reports on chargeback performance.

- Continuously improve dispute handling strategies.



IMPORTANT:



Chargeback management is a very important part of this position.



I am specifically looking for someone who already has experience handling Shopify Payments disputes and understands how to prepare strong evidence to maximize legitimate dispute success.



----------------------------------------



BONUSES AND PERFORMANCE REWARDS



In addition to your regular hourly salary, I want to reward employees who deliver excellent results.



1. CHARGEBACK WIN BONUSES



- Earn an additional bonus for eligible chargeback disputes successfully won.

- Bonuses will be based on verified dispute outcomes.

- The bonus structure will be explained and agreed upon before starting.

- Strong dispute management performance can lead to additional rewards.



2. PERFORMANCE-BASED BONUSES



Additional bonuses may be awarded for:



- Excellent customer support quality.

- Fast and accurate responses to customer inquiries.

- Consistently meeting agreed performance targets.

- Reliable and independent work.

- Improving customer satisfaction.

- Helping reduce preventable disputes.

- Improving workflows and overall efficiency.

- Taking initiative and solving problems independently.



3. SALARY GROWTH



- Opportunities for hourly salary increases based on performance.

- Additional compensation may be offered as responsibilities increase.

- Strong performers will be considered for future leadership opportunities.



I want to build a working relationship where excellent performance is recognized and rewarded.



----------------------------------------



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



- Minimum 1 year of hands-on Shopify customer support experience.

- Proven experience handling Shopify Payments chargebacks (REQUIRED).

- Experience managing multiple Shopify stores simultaneously.

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- A fast learner who can quickly understand new processes.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Honest, reliable, responsible, organized, and hardworking.

- Takes initiative instead of constantly waiting for instructions.

- Comfortable using e-commerce and customer service tools.

- Available to work on Saturdays and Sundays.

- Interested in growing professionally and taking on more responsibility.

- Looking for a stable, long-term position.



IMPORTANT:



I am NOT looking for a complete beginner.



I will personally explain my stores, policies, systems, and working methods during onboarding.



However, you must already have practical Shopify experience and be able to work independently after a short training period.



I am looking for someone who can take responsibility for their work and help make my daily operations easier.



----------------------------------------



WORKING HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Position: Full-Time / Long-Term

Working Hours: Approximately 30-40 hours per week

Saturday: Approximately 2-6 hours

Sunday: Approximately 2-6 hours

Schedule: Flexible, with agreed working hours and rest days

Training: Paid

Trial Period: Paid



ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION:



- Bonuses for eligible successfully won chargeback disputes.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for salary increases.

- Potential higher compensation with increased responsibilities.



Exact bonus arrangements will be discussed and agreed upon before employment begins.



----------------------------------------



YOUR FUTURE WITH MY BUSINESS



Because you will be my first employee, you will have a unique opportunity to grow alongside the business from the very beginning.



Initially, your main responsibilities will be customer support and chargeback management.



However, my goal is to expand my e-commerce business, hire additional employees, and build a strong international team over the coming years.



As the business grows, I want to give more responsibilities to people who have proven themselves to be trustworthy, capable, and motivated.



POTENTIAL FUTURE POSITIONS:



- Senior E-commerce Specialist

- Customer Support Team Leader

- Chargeback Management Lead

- E-commerce Operations Manager

- Team Manager



Depending on business growth and your performance, you may eventually become responsible for:



- Managing customer support across multiple stores.

- Training and supervising new employees.

- Leading the customer support team.

- Overseeing chargeback management.

- Improving daily e-commerce operations.

- Helping me organize and manage the business.

- Taking on important operational decisions within agreed responsibilities.



My intention is to build a team where dedicated employees have the opportunity to develop long-term careers.



I would love for my first employee to eventually become someone I can rely on to help lead the team.



These opportunities depend on business growth and individual performance, but I am serious about creating them.



----------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL the following questions:



1. How many years of Shopify customer support experience do you have?



2. Have you personally handled Shopify Payments chargebacks? Please describe your experience.



3. Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled, and what was your win rate?



4. Can you provide an anonymized example of a chargeback dispute you successfully handled?



5. Have you managed customer support for multiple Shopify stores simultaneously?



6. Which customer support tools and payment platforms have you used?



7. Are you available to work approximately 2-6 hours on both Saturdays and Sundays?



8. What is your expected hourly salary in USD, excluding performance bonuses?



9. When would you be available to start?



10. Would you be interested in growing into a leadership or management position in the future?



11. Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this long-term opportunity?



12. What would motivate you most in this position: career growth, performance bonuses, long-term stability, or a combination of these?



----------------------------------------



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Start your application with the word BLUEBIRD.



This helps me confirm that you have carefully read the entire job description.



Applications without this word or without answers to the questions may not be considered.



----------------------------------------



WHAT I OFFER



- A stable, long-term remote position.

- The opportunity to become my very first employee.

- An important role in a growing international e-commerce business.

- Direct communication and collaboration with the business owner.

- A friendly, respectful, and supportive working environment.

- Clear instructions and organized workflows.

- Paid onboarding and trial period.

- Flexible working arrangements.

- Bonuses for eligible successfully won chargeback disputes.

- Additional performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for salary increases.

- Potential growth into senior and management positions.

- The opportunity to help train and manage future employees.

- The chance to help build something successful from the beginning.



----------------------------------------



A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM ME



I want this position to be more than just a regular job.



I am looking for someone I can genuinely trust, someone who takes pride in their work, solves problems independently, and wants to achieve something meaningful together.



I am serious about growing my e-commerce business, and I believe that having the right people around me is one of the most important parts of that journey.



You do not need to know everything from day one.



What matters is that you already have a strong foundation, learn quickly, take responsibility, and genuinely care about delivering excellent work.



I want to create a professional relationship based on honesty, trust, respect, ambition, and long-term commitment.



I also believe that great work should be rewarded.



That is why I want to offer opportunities for performance bonuses, salary growth, and future promotions as the business expands.



My goal is that several years from now, we can look back and be proud of what we have built together.



I am not just looking for someone to work FOR me.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow WITH me.



If you are experienced, motivated, reliable, and excited about becoming the first member of a growing e-commerce business, I would genuinely love to hear from you.



I look forward to meeting you!

title: Residential CAD Drafter for US Homes (Part-Time)
description:
# Residential CAD Drafter for US Homes (Part-Time)



Noir Development builds new homes and duplexes in Dallas, Texas. We're hiring one part-time AutoCAD drafter to test-fit our house plans on lots, build our plan library, and prepare permit sets.



## The work



1. **Lot test-fits.** We send a lot's survey or parcel lines, the zoning setbacks and which of our plans to use. You place the plan, adjust the footprint to fit, and return a 1-page site plan with an area table. Turnaround is 1 business day.

2. **Plan library.** Draw our base plans from our briefs: two-story homes and duplexes. Every plan follows our cost rules:

   - simple footprints and one roof form

   - stacked, back-to-back plumbing

   - 2x6 walls at 24" on center

   - standard stock window sizes

3. **Permit sets.** Adapt a plan to a lot for a City of Dallas permit:

   - every sheet on our checklist

   - 5 business days from a complete brief

   - you confirm your hours before you start

   - framing stays inside IRC prescriptive limits

   - foundation and structural design come from a Texas PE, and engineered truss documents from the truss supplier



## Deliverables



Editable AutoCAD DWGs plus matching PDFs, with organized layers, dimensions, schedules and title blocks.



## You need



- AutoCAD. Revit is a plus

- 2 years drawing US residential plans, in feet and inches, to US code (IRC)

- Production-builder or value-engineering experience

- 2 hours a day of overlap with US Central time

- Clear written English



## Pay and terms



- US$7–9 per hour, about 20 hours a week (up to 86 hours a month), paid monthly for hours worked

- Paid tests first (US$20 and US$40, about 2 and 4 hours), then a paid 30-day trial

- Noir owns all drawings you make for us



## To apply



Reply with:

- "Dallas" on the first line

- 2 US residential plan sets, with the sheets you drew yourself marked

- One change you made to a plan that lowered its build cost, in 2–3 lines

- Confirmation that you deliver editable DWGs

- Your hourly rate

- Your hours of overlap with US Central time
