Include up to two group links, screenshots of group insights, or a short case study. Tell us what you personally did and how your role can be verified. Redacted evidence is welcome if client confidentiality applies. Do not share private member information.

You will be the first point of contact for new and existing clients, manage client files, and support our dispute team with the paperwork and follow-up that keeps cases on track. If you are detail-oriented, comfortable on the phone, and want to grow a career in credit and financial services, this role is for you.

What you will do

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style)



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

title: Full-Time DTC Video Editor – Skincare Brand | $5–$6/Hour + Up to $2,000 Per Winning Video
description:
We are looking for a full-time DTC Video Editor to join our growing skincare brand.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make beautiful-looking videos.



We care about one thing above everything else:



Does the creative make people stop, watch, and buy?



A simple video that converts is far more valuable to us than a cinematic edit that doesn’t generate sales.



You need to understand direct-response creative structure: hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, offers, CTAs, and why people keep watching or scroll away.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, take ownership of their work, continuously improve, and grow with us long term.





Compensation & Bonuses:



Base pay is $5–$6 per hour, depending on your experience and skill level.



But your base salary is only one part of your earning potential.



We have a strong performance-based bonus system where editors can earn up to $2,000 from a single winning video.



In strong months, there is potential to earn 3–5x your base salary through performance bonuses.



When the brand performs better, we all make more money together.



We also offer:



- Performance bonuses for winning creatives

- Annual tenure / loyalty bonuses

- Additional performance-based rewards

- Opportunities for higher compensation as you grow with the company



We want the people who help us grow to benefit from that growth as well.





What You’ll Be Doing:



You will be creating English-language direct-response video ads for a skincare DTC brand.



Your job will include:



- Editing performance-focused DTC creatives

- Turning scripts, concepts, footage, UGC, B-roll, and AI-generated content into finished ads

- Creating strong hooks that stop the scroll

- Creating and integrating AI-generated video scenes

- Improving creatives based on feedback and performance

- Continuously learning what makes an ad convert



We don’t expect every creative to look like a movie.



We expect you to understand why an ad works.





What We’re Looking For:



Previous experience creating video ads for DTC / Shopify brands is REQUIRED.



Please do not apply if you have only edited YouTube videos, wedding videos, gaming videos, corporate videos, or traditional social media content without direct-response e-commerce experience.



You should:



- Have experience editing DTC performance creatives

- Understand hooks, CTAs, pacing, retention, storytelling, and direct-response advertising

- Have experience creating AI-generated video content

- Have hands-on experience with Higgsfield

- Have experience with ElevenLabs

- Be highly comfortable with CapCut and/or Adobe editing software

- Be able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions for everything

- Be open to feedback and willing to improve quickly

- Have a strong desire to learn and develop your creative skills

- Be interested in a long-term position rather than a short-term freelance project





We Invest in Your Growth:



We’re not looking for someone to simply complete tasks for us.



We’re looking for someone we can grow with for years.



We have a large amount of internal training, creative frameworks, examples, resources, and educational material that we will share with you.



We continuously invest in new training and education, and we want to help you become a significantly better direct-response editor and creative thinker over time.



The better you become, the better our creatives become.



And when our creatives perform better, everyone wins.





Working Style:



100% Remote



You can set your own working hours.



We care much more about ownership, communication, deadlines, consistency, and output than the exact hours you choose to work.



We want a teammate who takes responsibility for their work and treats the brand like something they are helping build, not someone who simply clocks in and waits for instructions.





Hiring Process:



1. Short Test Task



A short unpaid test task that should take approximately 2–4 hours.



You will complete the test using your own tools.



You will have 48 hours to complete it.



2. Two-Week Paid Trial



If you pass the test, you will move into a two-week paid trial period.



During the trial, you will be expected to work a minimum of 20 hours per week.



The trial is fully paid, and from this stage onward, we will provide access to the paid tools required for the role.



3. Regular Contract



If the trial goes well and we are both happy working together, you will move into a regular long-term contract at your full salary, with access to our performance bonus system.





How to Apply:



Please send us the following:



1. How many years have you been editing videos?



2. Send us your portfolio of creatives that you personally edited.

(Please prioritize DTC / e-commerce advertising work.)



3. Send us your 3 best-performing videos separately.

(We specifically want to see the three creatives you believe achieved the strongest results.)



4. Give us a brief summary of your experience with:



- Higgsfield

- Chatgpt/Gemini

- ElevenLabs

- Shopify / DTC brands





IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the words: "BLACK"



If your application does not start with BLACK, your application will not be read.

title: LinkedIn Growth & Content Manager | Ghostwriting, Personal Branding & Lead Generation
description:
We’re hiring a full-time LinkedIn Growth & Content Manager to take ownership of our founder’s LinkedIn presence and eventually manage additional client accounts.



We’re looking for someone who knows LinkedIn inside and out. Someone who can write exceptional content, grow an audience, build relationships, and turn LinkedIn activity into real business opportunities.



This isn’t just a ghostwriting or social media scheduling role. You’ll own the entire LinkedIn process, from strategy and content creation to publishing, engagement, direct messages, and performance.



You’ll work directly with our founder, who provides overall business direction, positioning, and personal insights. Your responsibility is to turn that into a growing, active LinkedIn presence that attracts the right people.



Who You Are



You’re a LinkedIn specialist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, read, engage, and follow.



You’re an excellent ghostwriter who can capture someone’s personality, find compelling stories in everyday conversations, and write content that sounds genuinely human.



You understand both sides of LinkedIn growth: creating content that attracts attention and proactively building relationships with the right people.



You’re comfortable starting conversations through DMs, responding to inbound messages, identifying potential opportunities, and knowing when to involve the founder.



You use AI to work efficiently, but you have the judgment to improve what it produces rather than simply publishing it.



Most importantly, you’re proactive, organized, analytical, and comfortable taking ownership without constant direction.



About the Company



We’re a growing US-based boutique consulting and marketing firm serving real estate investment companies and developers.



Our services include brand positioning, websites, CRM systems, organic marketing, newsletters, webinars, and investor communication.



Key Responsibilities



LinkedIn Strategy & Content



* Develop content pillars, editorial calendars, and growth strategies.

* Ghostwrite engaging LinkedIn posts for founders and executives.

* Turn interviews, transcripts, meetings, and personal experiences into compelling content.

* Create LinkedIn carousels, graphics, and other supporting assets.

* Research relevant topics, trends, and content opportunities.

* Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to improve production efficiency.

* Manage content approvals, scheduling, and publishing.



Audience Growth & Engagement



* Develop and execute an organic LinkedIn audience growth strategy.

* Engage daily with relevant posts, creators, prospects, and industry conversations.

* Write thoughtful comments that build visibility and relationships.

* Respond to comments on published posts.

* Identify relevant accounts and communities for ongoing engagement.

* Grow a relevant audience of potential clients, partners, and industry professionals.



LinkedIn DMs & Lead Generation



* Identify and connect with relevant prospects through targeted outreach.

* Write personalized outbound LinkedIn DMs that initiate genuine conversations.

* Manage inbound DMs, connection requests, and follow-up conversations.

* Qualify potential leads and identify business opportunities.

* Maintain organized records of conversations and follow-ups.

* Hand off qualified prospects to the founder for sales conversations.

* Develop and improve outreach messaging based on response rates and results.



We’re not interested in mass messaging, spam, or aggressive sales tactics. We want someone who understands relationship-based outreach and can represent our brand professionally.



Analytics & Account Management



* Track impressions, engagement, follower growth, profile visits, and inbound leads.

* Monitor connection acceptance, DM response rates, and qualified conversations.

* Analyze content performance and recommend improvements.

* Maintain organized content calendars, outreach trackers, and reporting.

* Continuously test and improve content, engagement, and outreach strategies.

* Manage the day-to-day LinkedIn presence with minimal oversight.



What Success Looks Like



* Excellent Content: Posts consistently reflect the founder’s voice and require minimal editing.

* Audience Growth: Relevant followers, engagement, and visibility increase over time.

* Meaningful Relationships: Daily activity creates conversations with the right people.

* Qualified Opportunities: Inbound and outbound activity generates relevant business conversations.

* Consistent Execution: Content, engagement, and outreach happen reliably without reminders.

* Ownership: You proactively identify opportunities, improve performance, and keep everything moving.



Our goal is to provide strategic direction and trust you to handle the daily execution required to grow LinkedIn into a meaningful business development channel.



Required Qualifications



* 3+ years of professional LinkedIn content, growth, or personal brand management experience.

* Proven experience managing and growing LinkedIn profiles for founders, executives, or B2B businesses.

* Excellent written English, ghostwriting, storytelling, and editing skills.

* Thorough understanding of LinkedIn content strategy, engagement, and organic growth.

* Experience managing outbound LinkedIn outreach and inbound DM conversations.

* Ability to identify, qualify, and nurture potential business leads.

* Strong proficiency with ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools.

* Experience with LinkedIn scheduling, analytics, and content management tools.

* Strong organization, communication, and independent problem-solving skills.

* Ability to manage multiple brand voices and client accounts.



Preferred: Experience with real estate, financial services, B2B lead generation, Canva, CRM systems, and LinkedIn outreach tools.



Schedule & Growth Opportunity



Full-time, 40 hours per week.



Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM US Central Time, including a 1-hour break.



This schedule is required, including adjustments for US daylight saving time. Morning availability is important for publishing, engagement, and responding to messages.



We’re looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity with room to grow into a senior LinkedIn growth or marketing leadership role as our business expands.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. LinkedIn Portfolio: Links to LinkedIn profiles you’ve personally managed, including examples of posts you’ve ghostwritten.

2. Growth Results: Share specific results you’ve achieved, including audience growth, engagement, inbound leads, or booked conversations.

3. Outreach Experience: Describe your approach to outbound DMs, inbound messages, lead qualification, and follow-up.

4. AI Workflow: Explain how you use AI to produce authentic content and manage LinkedIn efficiently.

5. Availability: Confirm you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM US Central Time.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a skills assessment.

title: Creative Social Media Marketer – $200 Idea Contest + Part-Time Role (US Audience)
description:
I run a small US-focused affiliate marketing business. I’m looking for creative, resourceful people who think differently, not people who follow the same playbook everyone else uses.



About the Offer

I promote a free-to-enter sweepstakes where one winner receives a $500 grocery gift card. People answer 3 quick questions on my landing page, then enter on our partner’s sweepstakes site. It’s free and open to US residents only.



👉 See the funnel here: 



The audience is mostly US adults 35+, especially women, who feel the pressure of grocery prices and like saving money or winning prizes.



Feel free to click through and look at the page, but please do NOT submit the final entry form. It’s US-only, and test entries hurt my account.



The Contest

Pitch me your most original idea for getting real people to the page without paid ads.



Think outside the box. It does NOT have to be social media. It could be a website or tool, a partnership, a community, a newsletter, a piece of content people can’t help sharing, an offline idea, a clever use of a platform nobody thinks of. Ideas that are unusual but realistic will win. “Post in
 groups” will not.



Bonus points if your idea can be scaled or automated over time.



What to Submit



Your idea in under 300 words: what it is, where the people come from, and why they would actually care

One example or mockup showing what it would look like (Canva, a sketch, a screenshot, anything)

How the link fits in naturally, without it feeling like spam

How it could grow: what it looks like at 10x the size, and what could be automated

A 1–2 minute voice recording or Loom video of you explaining your idea in your own words. Applications without this will not be reviewed.



No AI-Written Applications

You may use AI tools for research, but the idea and the writing must be your own. AI-generated ideas and applications are easy to spot and will be ignored. I’d much rather read simple, honest English with a genuinely original idea than a polished AI essay.



Rules (ideas that break these are disqualified)



No fake accounts, bots, comment/DM spam, or buying followers

No fake testimonials or “I won” claims

Never imply it’s a government program, stimulus, or free money

Must follow the rules of whatever platform or channel you use



Prizes



🥇 Best idea: $200

🥈 2nd place: $50

🥉 3rd place: $50

Top submissions get first priority for a paid part-time role ($400–600/month) helping run the winning idea. Strong performance can grow into full-time.



Who Should Apply



People who notice what makes Americans click, share and talk

Creative problem-solvers. Marketing experience helps but isn’t required

Good written and spoken English

Experience with affiliate marketing, lead generation, SEO, or growing online communities is a big plus



Payment

Prizes paid via PayPal or Wise within 7 days of the winners being announced.



Deadline: Wednesday, November 19, 2026, 11:59 PM (Philippine Time)



How to Apply

Start your application with the word “GROCERY” so I know you read the whole post. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.

Send your idea, example and voice recording in one message. Links to Google Docs, Google Drive, Canva or Loom are fine (make sure they’re set to “anyone with the link can view”).



Due to the number of applications, I can only reply to the winners and shortlisted applicants. Thank you for your creativity!

title: Multimedia Designer (Print Production, Packaging & Motion)
description:
Multimedia Designer

Remote (Philippines) | USD $1,400–$1,700/month | Hong Kong hours | Shortlisted candidates may be hired by November 27



You bring the good eye and the trends.

We'll teach you to bring them to life with AI.



You'll support the creative director of a fast-growing sexual wellness brand. Its products have reached about 1.5 million customers, and it works more and more with B-list to A-list celebrities and shows.



What matters most is your taste, your finger on the pulse of what's trending, and your love of product design. The creative director will lead the work and train you on AI tools, so the passionate, interesting and fun ideas you bring can actually come to life.



---



About Ally

Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies. We place talented specialists inside e-commerce and creative businesses, working with modern AI tools. You'll sit inside the client's creative team, close to the work and the decisions.



---



What you'll do

• Support the creative director on art direction for campaigns, launches, celebrity collaborations, product branding design and packaging design.

• Bring trend finds and inspo to the table, then help turn the creative director's briefs into mood boards, visual directions and style frames, refining them based on feedback.

• Explore product design ideas with AI tools, from colourways and finishes to packaging and limited drops, with the creative director guiding the direction.

• Help plan and prep product shoots, from set and prop styling to colour direction and shot list.

• Create and look after brand assets: campaign key visuals, social content, product imagery and brand templates.

• Use AI image and design tools to explore and produce work quickly. The creative director will train you on these.

• Keep each product line's colour and visual system consistent across packaging, the website and social.



---



What we're looking for in you

• Always on top of trends. You keep up with what's trending across social, culture, fashion, beauty and design, and you see it as inspo for products and campaigns.

• A passion for product design. You've always wanted to design products but never had the chance to really play with it. With how strong AI tools are now, this is that chance.

• Fun, interesting ideas, brought to life. You get excited about playful, slightly unexpected ideas, and you're keen to make them real with AI and the creative director's lead.

• A feel for bold, clean, product-led visuals: strong single-colour backdrops, simple compositions, and the product as the hero.

• Can make an intimate product feel playful, approachable and premium, never awkward or explicit.

• Understands colour as a brand tool: building palettes and carrying a colour system across product lines and campaigns.

• Thinks in systems, not one-offs: how a look carries across packaging, the website, social and ads.

• Gets the tone of the category: confident and fun, but always safe and trustworthy.



---



The pace

Launches overlap, celebrity and show timelines move, and briefs can change mid-week. You'll juggle several requests from the creative director at once, and you'll need to keep both the quality bar and the brand consistent.



---



This role is for you if you

• Are always saving, screenshotting and sharing what's trending, and can explain why it's catching on.

• Have a passion for product design and want the chance to finally play with it.

• Enjoy supporting a creative director, learning from them, and being trained on AI tools to bring ideas to life.

• Love building brands, not just making single graphics.



---



It's probably not for you if you

• Need a fixed weekly routine.

• Aren't comfortable working with sexual wellness products.



---



What we're looking for

• 2+ years in design or art direction, ideally at a brand, agency or studio.

• Experience supporting a creative director or art director. This is strongly preferred.

• A portfolio that shows strong taste and brand thinking: campaigns, brand identities or brand asset systems.

• Strong Adobe skills (Photoshop, Illustrator) and comfort in Canva and Figma. Basic video editing is a plus.

• An interest in AI design tools (e.g., Midjourney, Firefly, generative tools in Photoshop). The creative director will train you, so we don't expect you to know them yet.

• Nice to have: packaging or print production experience (CMYK, production files etc), or any personal product design sketches or experiments, however rough.

• Clear English, and comfort with async work and quick revisions.



---



What you'll get

• USD 1,400–1,700/month, depending on experience.

• Full-time, long-term and fully remote from the Philippines, as an independent contractor.

• Hong Kong hours (9am–6pm) on weekdays, with occasional weekend flexibility around launches.

• Mentorship and hands-on training from the brand's creative director, including AI tools, so you can finally bring your product design ideas to life.



---



How to apply

Apply here: 



Bring your CV and a portfolio link, plus one 2–3 minute Loom:

1. Introduce yourself and walk us through one project where you supported the visual direction (a shoot, campaign or brand system) and note your role.

2. We'd also love to see 2–3 trends you're excited about right now, and how one could inspire a product.



If you live for trends, love product design and want a creative director to help you grow, apply today.

title: Biology/Chemistry/Environmental Science Tutor
description:
Job Title: Academic Tutor (Biology / Chemistry / Environmental Studies)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Type: Part-Time

Reports To: Director of Academic Programs





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Telos Prep is seeking an ethical, professional, and reliable Biology / Chemistry / Environmental Studies Tutor based in the Philippines to join our remote team. We support U.S.-based high school students through a team-based model, where each student is guided by a Head Counselor, Essay Editor, and Subject Tutors. As a tutor, you'll provide subject-specific support to help our students strengthen their academic foundations and prepare confidently for AP (Advanced Placement) coursework and exams — these are college-level classes that American high school students take to earn college credit.





WHAT YOU'LL DO:

> Subject-Specific Tutoring: Tutor Biology, Chemistry, and Environmental Science at the AP and Honors levels (Honors = advanced high school courses). You should be strong in Biology or Chemistry (or both) and interested in teaching both. Telos can train the right candidate in the second subject. Experience teaching AP Biology and AP Chemistry is a big plus. Familiarity with the AP curricula (including AP Environmental Science ("APES")), the format of their exams, and how the FRQs (Free-Response Questions — the written/essay portion of AP exams) are scored is preferred, but not required — Telos can help you build this.

> Student-Centered Instruction: Use a Socratic teaching style — meaning you guide students to the answer through questions instead of lecturing at them. Explain tough concepts (e.g., cellular respiration, ecological succession, photosynthesis) in simple language, and figure out why a student is stuck (vocabulary gap, misread question, or missing background knowledge) before re-teaching. Make abstract concepts vivid and relatable — connect ideas into a bigger picture rather than dumping information, so sessions feel engaging and dynamic, never like a one-way lecture.

> Interactive Teaching: Run interactive sessions using screen-share / present mode, live annotation, past exam papers, and resources like Khan Academy. Keep students actively participating so they don't disengage.

> Lab & Exam Strategy: Coach students through experimental design, data interpretation, and AP-style "design-and-justify" FRQs (where students design an experiment and explain their reasoning), alongside multiple-choice strategy for AP Bio, AP Chem, and APES.

> Team Collaboration: Work closely with the student's Head Counselor so your tutoring supports the student's bigger academic and college-admissions plan — not just the next test.

> Prompt, Prepared Communication: Reply to messages from students, parents, and the Telos team within 24 business hours. Prepare before every session, take clear session notes, track student progress, and raise any concerns early.





WHO YOU ARE:

> Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Biology, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Pre-Med, STEM Education, or a closely related scientific field is required. A Pre-Med, lab research, or graduate-level science background is a plus.

> Tutoring Experience: Prior tutoring experience is preferred — ideally one-on-one experience tutoring high school students in Biology and/or Chemistry, and even better at the AP or Honors level. We are *not* looking for someone with extensive or college-level teaching experience — what we prioritize most is relatability and patience, since our students range from highly accelerated to those needing more remedial support. Because this role is very one-on-one heavy, genuine 1:1 experience matters more than classroom hours alone, though strong classroom teachers are very welcome. Experience tutoring SAT or ACT Science (the major U.S. college entrance exams) or other standardized science tests is a bonus.

> Warm & Approachable: You come across as the kind of person a teenager actually wants to keep working with — patient, encouraging, and never intimidating.

> U.S. High School Context (Preferred, not required): Ideally familiar with how the U.S. high school system works — including AP exams, GPA (Grade Point Average — the standard U.S. academic average, usually on a 4.0 scale), transcripts, and how American teens approach college admissions — even while based in the Philippines.

> Cross-Cultural Communication: Communicate clearly and warmly with U.S. students and parents in fluent, natural-sounding English, and stay professional across time zones.

> Mission-Aligned: Excited about Telos's team-based, mentorship-oriented, "AI-Enhanced but Human-Centered" model — not looking for a generic tutoring side gig.

> Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working in a fully remote, AI-enhanced environment, including using tools like Claude, Gemini, or NotebookLM to help prepare lessons.

> Continuous Learner: You bring a never-stop-learning mindset and are willing to stretch across adjacent material (e.g., AP Biology, AP Chemistry, and Environmental Science) as student needs shift. If you're stronger in either Biology or Chemistry, you're willing to learn the other — Telos can provide training.





SCHEDULE & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

> Fully Remote: This role is 100% remote, allowing you to conduct tutoring sessions from the comfort of your home.

> Tech Setup & Workspace Requirements: Because this role is highly collaborative, your tech setup and environment are really important to us. Clear camera quality is essential since we highly value professionalism during our client-facing meetings. Additionally, having a crisp microphone and a relatively quiet, well-lit workspace ensures our AI tools (like Gemini) can capture accurate meeting transcripts for our notes and timesheets.

> Set Your Own Availability: As a tutor, you have the flexibility to set and manage your own schedule. Because we provide a highly personalized service tailored to each student's unique needs, sessions are booked based on the student's specific requests.

> Peak Tutoring Hours: While you control your calendar, our highest demand from students falls during their free time. These peak hours are based on the student's local time zone (primarily Pacific Time / PT):

    - Weekday After-School Hours: Typically 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM in the student's time zone. Opening slots during these windows will yield the highest volume of bookings.

    - Weekends: Optional, mutually agreed-upon times if both you and the student are available.





HOLIDAYS & TIME OFF

> Philippine Holidays: The Contractor is entitled to paid time off for all regular Philippine holidays included in the company's officially provided vacation and PTO policy. These holidays are observed in PHT and include:

    - January 1: New Year's Day

    - April 2: Maundy Thursday

    - April 3: Good Friday

    - April 9: Araw ng Kagitingan (Day of Valor)

    - May 1: Labor Day

    - June 12: Independence Day

    - August 31: National Heroes Day

    - November 30: Bonifacio Day

    - December 25: Christmas Day

    - December 30: Rizal Day

> Sick Leave: Provided on an as-needed basis, contingent upon reasonable usage and timely notification.

> Work-Life Balance: The Company maintains a flexible and supportive approach to time-off requests, with a commitment to approving leave whenever possible to support your well-being.





WHAT WE OFFER:

> Pay: $5/hour

> Resources: Telos will provide the necessary software subscriptions and tools required for the role (e.g. Google Workspace account, work tablet if needed)





HOW TO APPLY:

> Send your *updated* resume to our
 address: 
 (you may address your
 to the Telos Prep Team).

> IMPORTANT: Please indicate the position you're applying for in the
 subject (e.g. "Application for Biology/Chemistry Tutor")

- Edit talking-head footage and exercise demonstrations into YouTube videos. Choose the best takes, remove repetition, balance the audio, and use close-ups where they help viewers see the movement.

- Find moments that work as standalone clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and TikTok. Reframe the footage vertically, keep the exercise visible, and check captions against what I actually say.

- Prepare thumbnails, titles, descriptions, and captions using OC360’s black, electric blue, and white branding.

- Send me a review link, make revisions, and schedule approved content on all four platforms. Check each published post and add its link to our content calendar.



Our target is three YouTube videos per week. We’ll prioritize those edits first and agree on how many short clips fit the remaining hours.



**What I’m looking for**



You're highly experienced editing YouTube videos and vertical clips, can write clear English captions, and have experience scheduling social posts. Use the editor you know best. Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Descript is welcome. Fitness editing experience is a plus.



**How to apply**



Send one YouTube video and one vertical clip you personally edited. Tell me what you handled on each, which platforms you’ve published to, and your usual weekly availability. Please also tell me how long it took you to edit the YouTube sample. A portfolio link and a short reply are enough.

title: Part-Time AI Video Editor - Higgsfield + Suno | Pixar-Style Supplement Ads
description:
We're hiring a part-time AI video creator/editor to produce Pixar-style animated videos for a supplement brand specializing in female-optimized beef organ supplements.



This role starts at approximately 20 hours per month, with the possibility of gradually increasing hours based on performance. We're looking for demonstrated experience creating similar videos. Your relevant portfolio and the quality of your creative decisions will carry the most weight.



THE CREATIVE DIRECTION

Expressive, original 3D characters, cinematic lighting, humor, catchy music, and strong storytelling for an adult female audience. You should be able to turn a concept or approved script into a polished short-form video with a clear hook, story, and call to action.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

HOURS, PAY, AND GROWTH

Saturday Is a Major Part of This Position

The Hybrid VA will be the primary VA working on Saturdays.

Escalating serious situations when appropriate

title: Multi-Device QA Tester
description:
We're looking for a hands-on QA tester to test Gather the way real people use it: one person sends an invitation from their phone, other people get it by text on their phones, they respond, and everyone's screens need to show the right thing. Most of what we need tested involves several people on several devices at the same time, using real phone numbers and real text messages.



Please read before applying



Don't apply unless you have hands-on experience testing multi-user journeys across separate physical phones with real phone numbers. This role is not single-device app testing, emulator-only testing, automated-script-only testing, or testing over
. If your experience is mainly one of those, this isn't the right fit, and applications that don't show multi-device experience won't be reviewed.



You'll need at least three physical phones with active numbers that can send and receive SMS, including at least one iPhone and one Android.



About Gather



Gather helps people plan get-togethers and get the right people there. A host creates a gathering and invites guests, mostly by text message. Guests open the invitation, respond, and the host sees responses come in. Almost every feature has at least two sides, and those sides are usually on different phones, carriers and operating systems.



Why this testing is hard



• Every interaction has two (or more) ends. The host sends, the guest receives; the guest responds, the host's view updates. A bug may only show up on one side, so both sides have to be watched at the same time.

• Real text messages behave differently from phone to phone. iMessage vs. SMS vs. RCS, link previews that do or don't render, shortened links, carrier filtering, delayed or out-of-order delivery, and replies like STOP.

• Guests arrive in different states. With the app or without it, first-time or returning, link opening in the browser vs. the app, logged in or not.

• Things change after the invite goes out. A host edits the time, a guest changes their answer, an event is cancelled, reminders fire, two people respond at the same moment, someone is offline.

• The phone number is the identity. The same person on two devices, numbers in different formats, a number already tied to an account, a contact with more than one number.

• Notifications overlap. Push notifications and texts can duplicate, arrive in the wrong order, or not arrive at all.



What you'll do



• Run end-to-end journeys across at least three physical phones with real numbers, playing host and guests at once.

• Write and maintain test cases for multi-person scenarios, including what each person should see at each step.

• Capture evidence from every side: screenshots or screen recordings from each phone, with timestamps so we can line up what happened where.

• Report bugs with clear repro steps, which side it happened on, device, OS version, carrier, app/browser, and time.

• Run regression passes on each release before it goes out.

• Flag things that are confusing, not just broken: how the invite reads in a text thread, whether a guest knows what to do next, whether the host can tell who has responded.



Example scenarios you'd test



1.  Host invites three guests by phone number: an iPhone with the app, an Android without the app, and an iPhone with iMessage turned off. Does each text arrive, how does it look, does the link work, can each guest respond, and does the host's view update correctly?

2.  A guest responds yes, then changes to no. What does the host see, and are they notified?

3.  The host changes the time after invites are sent. Does every guest get the update, and does the message make sense on its own?

4.  A guest forwards the invitation text to someone who wasn't invited. What happens when that person taps the link?

5.  A guest replies directly to the text instead of tapping the link.

6.  A guest replies STOP. What happens to future messages for that guest and on the host's side?

7.  Two guests respond within seconds of each other.

8.  A guest opens the invite, goes offline, and responds later.

9.  The host invites a number that's invalid or a landline.

10.  The host cancels the gathering. What does every guest see, in the app and by text?



Must have

title: Experienced Cold Calling Appointment Setter (Part Time, US Hours) for a Commercial Cleaning Company
description:
Keeper Facility Care is a commercial cleaning company serving Fairfield County, Connecticut and Westchester County, New York (
). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at the offices we serve and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners.



THE JOB

You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator, managing partner or owner.



Your standard is 150 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once.



Your work:

You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them.

You follow up by
, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you.

You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted.

You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking.



Your rules:

You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call.



Most calls end at the front desk or in voi
. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing.



HOW WE SELL

This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a business: its customers, its staff and its reputation.



HOURS

20 hours per week, Monday to Thursday, 5 hours a day. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is currently 11 PM to 1 AM and 2 AM to 5 AM, and it shifts by one hour when US clocks change in March. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers.



PAY

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer.

$10 for every walkthrough that actually happens.

$50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice.

Bonuses are extra and not promised.



TRIAL

The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d
 whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one.



WE PROVIDE

A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week.



YOU NEED

You must have worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company: commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services. At least 3 years of outbound cold calling appointment setting, and at least part of it for a cleaning company, booking appointments with US businesses. If you have not worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company, do not apply.

You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's.

A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script.

Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes.

Clear, neutral spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call, with no heavy accent and no strong regional pronunciation.

A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed.



HOW TO APPLY

Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, $5 to $7 per hour, [your name]. We do not read messages without it.



Then send:



1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. Then imagine you reached the office manager at a dental office and said: "Hi, this is [your name] with Keeper Facility Care. We provide janitorial service to offices near you. Are you the person who d
 on cleaning?" The manager says: "We already have a cleaner." Answer in your own words and ask for a 15 minute walkthrough. We listen for clear, neutral English and a natural tone. Make sure the link opens without a login.

2. Your cleaning company experience: the company name, your role, how long you worked there, who you called, calls per day, and your best measurable result, such as appointments booked per week. Then your total years of cold calling appointment setting.

3. The CRMs you have used.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Your upload speed, your headset model, and a yes or no: can you work the hours above every week?



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed. Finalists do a 10 minute live role-play call with Johan.



Applications close Wednesday, November 18 at 11:59 PM Philippine time. We reply only to finalists, by Friday, November 20.



Johan Montenegro, Keeper Facility Care

About the Client 

Pacific Pact is recruiting for this role on behalf of a client headquartered in Utah, USA. The client specializes in simplifying and securing device management through innovative technology solutions. Its products help IT teams streamline operations, improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and maintain greater control over their IT environments.

About the Role 

The client's platform is a cloud-based solution for managing Apple devices (macOS, iOS, iPadOS, tvOS) at scale. It enables organizations to manage their Apple devices without unnecessary complexity. 



Our client is seeking a Solutions Engineer dedicated to supporting Apple device management and other macOS platform needs across its products. In this role, you will support Apple device management via cloud platforms. That means helping IT administrators manage their Apple device fleets successfully. You will also work closely alongside the client's product team to make sure it keeps pace with how Apple admins actually work. 



This is not an entry-level support job; you'll troubleshoot complex issues across the Apple ecosystem and work directly with tech-savvy customers (often fellow sysadmins like yourself). We're looking for someone with the autonomy, technical depth, and customer focus to take on sophisticated customer problems and drive them to resolution.

   • (Optional) Contribute to video or webinar content.

   • Collaborate with U.S.-based support, product, and engineering teams. 

 Proactive Improvement 

   • Stay current on Apple platform updates, MDM changes, and best practices. 

   • Improve team processes, tool usage, and customer experience workflows. 



We're Looking for People Who Have (Required) 

   • 4+ years of hands-on experience administering Apple devices at scale with a commercial MDM platform (e.g., Jamf Pro, Mosyle, Iru/Kandji, Intune). This is a firm requirement: you should have lived in an MDM console day to day, not just used one occasionally. 

   • Candidates with less experience may also be considered if they are trainable. 

   • Familiar with Apple MDM protocol and Declarative Device Management (DDM). You can explain MDM commands and declarations: you understand how they work, and can troubleshoot issues as they occur. 

   • Strong knowledge of macOS and iOS operating systems and troubleshooting. 

   • Strong knowledge of Apple Business Manager, DEP/ADE workflows, app licensing and packaging, configuration profiles, and device enrollment. 

   • Basic understanding of APNs and network prerequisites for Apple MDM. 

   • Strong sysadmin-level troubleshooting skills and autonomy in high-context environments. 

   • Basic knowledge of bash, zsh, Python, or Ruby scripting for automation, log parsing, or API interaction, etc.

   • Working written and spoken English for support and collaboration with U.S.-based teams. 

   • Emotional intelligence: You stay calm and address problems steadily, including when customers are frustrated. 

   • Customer communication fueled by empathy, urgency, and a willingness to solve problems for customers at any technical level. 



Nice to Have (Not Required) 

   • Experience with Munki, AutoPkg, and/or other open-source Mac management and software packaging tools. 

   • Experience supporting mixed environments (Windows and Apple). 

   • Experience using version control and related tools (git, GitHub, etc.). 

   • Experience in IaC environments and related tools (Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Salt, etc.).

   • Familiarity with support platforms: Zendesk, Slack, Notion, Linear.

title: Full-Stack Developer | Backend Integration & Software QA
description:
We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Developer to assist with the final development, integration, testing and commercial launch of a software platform designed for the real estate and property management industry in Australia.



The platform has already been developed and is approaching its commercial launch. We are looking for a technically experienced individual who can review the existing software, finalise outstanding development work, ensure all integrations and backend systems are functioning correctly, and prepare the product for licensing to real estate agencies and property management businesses.



This is not a project to build software from scratch. We need someone who can confidently work with an existing codebase, identify and resolve technical issues, and take ownership of the final stages of development.



Key Responsibilities



1. Backend Development & System Optimisation



Review and audit the existing software architecture and codebase.

Identify and resolve outstanding bugs, errors and technical issues.

Ensure backend systems, databases and server-side functions operate reliably.

Optimise system performance, speed and stability.

Complete any outstanding development requirements.



2. API Integrations & Data Connections



Review, test and finalise existing third-party API integrations.

Ensure data transfers and synchronisation work accurately and consistently.

Troubleshoot broken connections, authentication issues and API errors.

Implement appropriate error handling, logging and monitoring.

Document integrations and their ongoing maintenance requirements.



3. Software Testing & Quality Assurance



Conduct comprehensive end-to-end testing of the platform.

Test all features, dashboards, user workflows and system functionality.

Identify, document and resolve bugs before commercial launch.

Conduct cross-browser, mobile and desktop compatibility testing.

Validate data accuracy, reliability and performance.

Perform regression testing following updates and bug fixes.



4. Security, User Access & Licensing



Review user authentication, account access and permissions.

Ensure appropriate separation and protection of data between customer accounts.

Test account creation, onboarding and licensing workflows.

Identify potential security vulnerabilities and recommend improvements.

Ensure the platform is technically prepared to support multiple paying customers.



5. Pre-Launch Preparation & Support



Work closely with the software owner to identify outstanding development priorities.

Prepare a clear list of issues, required fixes and launch-critical tasks.

Complete final testing and technical checks before launch.

Provide technical documentation and handover notes.

Assist with troubleshooting and ongoing software maintenance following launch.



Required Skills & Experience



Proven experience in full-stack software development, with strong backend capabilities.

Experience working with existing SaaS platforms or web applications.

Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.

Strong knowledge of software testing and quality assurance practices.

Understanding of user authentication, security and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

Ability to work independently, identify problems and implement solutions.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable taking technical ownership of an existing software product. The ideal candidate will be able to assess the current state of the platform, identify what needs to be completed, provide realistic development timelines and independently work through technical challenges. Our priority is ensuring the software is fully functional, secure, reliable and ready for commercial use before we begin licensing it to customers.



How to Apply? 



Please submit your CV or portfolio highlighting relevant SaaS development experience. Examples of existing software products you have developed, maintained or helped launch. Details of your experience with API integrations and backend development. Also include a brief explanation of how you would approach auditing and preparing an existing SaaS product for commercial launch.



We are looking to engage the right candidate as soon as possible, with the opportunity for an ongoing working relationship following launch.

Required Qualifications

• Strong scripting ability in PowerShell; Python or Bash a plus

This is a high-ownership, fast-paced role for someone who doesn't just follow creative briefs but actively shapes brand identities, anticipates trends, drives innovative concepts and takes charge of the entire creative process, from strategy and product development to campaigns and execution.

We want someone who recognises emerging visual trends, understands what resonates with today's audiences and can transform those influences into original, distinctive and commercially impactful designs.



Beyond creativity, we expect strong leadership, exceptional initiative, independent decision-making and the ability to deliver premium-quality work with fast turnaround times. You should be able to take an idea from zero to launch, manage multiple creative priorities and consistently deliver without constant supervision.



This is not a conventional graphic design position. We are looking for someone who can lead, create, innovate and take complete ownership of our brands' creative evolution.



### Key Responsibilities



- Brand Identity & Art Direction: Develop original logos, visual identities, typography, colour palettes, brand guidelines and creative concepts. Restructure and elevate existing brand directions.

- Sports & Lifestyle Creative Direction: Create trend-driven concepts inspired by modern running brands, run clubs, HYROX, athletic communities, performance apparel and contemporary sports culture.

- Product & Packaging Design: Lead packaging, labelling, flavour concepts, colourways, product themes, 3D mockups and complete creative development for product launches.

- Static & Motion Creatives: Produce high-quality social media content, event posters, race graphics, digital advertisements, motion graphics, animations and short-form videos.

- Campaign Development: Independently conceptualise and execute creative campaigns, from moodboards and visual storytelling to final marketing assets.

- Creative Planning & Execution: Manage creative calendars, scheduling, production timelines and multiple projects with fast turnaround and consistent on-time delivery.

- Leadership & Initiative: Take charge of creative projects, make independent decisions, identify areas for improvement and proactively introduce new concepts without waiting for instructions.

- AI & Creative Innovation: Utilise advanced AI tools for image generation, video production, concept development and efficient creative workflows.

- Trend Research: Stay ahead of emerging design trends, typography, editorial layouts, sports branding and creative movements across fashion and lifestyle industries.



### Required Skills & Experience



- Minimum 5 years of relevant professional creative design experience.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro and related software.

- Strong expertise in branding, typography, art direction, product packaging and visual storytelling.

- Proven ability to create contemporary, unconventional and trend-relevant designs.

- Strong understanding of running culture, HYROX, performance sports, activewear and modern fitness branding.

- Experience in motion graphics, video editing and performance advertising creatives.

- Proficiency in AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Kling or equivalent.

- Experience with Blender, Cinema 4D or other 3D design tools is advantageous.

title: Senior Bookkeeper | Australian Bookkeeping Firm | WFH

Maintain accurate employee records and payroll documentation.



Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies.



Stay informed about changes to Australian payroll legislation and compliance requirements.



Month-End Reporting & Compliance



Complete monthly reconciliations within established deadlines.



Ensure balance sheet accounts are accurate and supported by workpapers.



Prepare GST reconciliations and BAS/IAS supporting schedules.



Assist with month-end and year-end financial processes.



Identify unusual transactions, errors or potential compliance issues.



Ensure all work is completed in accordance with Balanced Advisory Co's established procedures.



Essential Requirements



Minimum 3–5 years of recent bookkeeping experience working with Australian businesses.



Advanced knowledge and practical experience using Xero Accounting.



Extensive hands-on experience with Xero Payroll.



Strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation, Modern Awards, Fair Work requirements, superannuation, PAYG withholding and STP.



Proven experience independently managing bookkeeping and payroll for multiple Australian clients.



Strong understanding of Australian GST and BAS requirements.



Excellent bank, balance sheet and payroll reconciliation skills.



Experience preparing month-end financial reports and supporting workpapers.



Strong attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



Ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently.



A professional attitude, strong work ethic and commitment to confidentiality.

Previous employment within an Australian bookkeeping or accounting firm.



Xero Advisor Certification and Xero Payroll Certification.



Experience using MYOB.



Experience working with Australian law firms, real estate agencies or other professional services businesses.



Experience preparing monthly management reports.



Experience with Australian payroll tax and workers' compensation reporting.



Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint.

What We Offer

title: Remote Sales Rep, Quote Calls & Bookings (Full-Time, Mon–Fri, Base + Commission)
description:
Keep It Tidy Home Care is a fast-growing residential and commercial cleaning company in the GTA, Ontario. We’re looking for a friendly, quick-to-respond rep to turn new quote requests into booked cleans.

The job is simple:

Our leads come in from Meta ads and our website. When someone submits a quote, call them as fast as you can, ideally within 2 to 3 minutes.

Quotes that come in after 7 PM or on the weekend: call first thing the next business morning (11 AM, Monday to Friday).

Expect about 5–6 calls a day. Quick, friendly conversations.

Give the quote from our pricing sheet and book the job on the call.

Log the booking details in our calendar: address, service, special instructions and cleaner slot.

Answer inbound calls and follow up by text when needed.

When you work:

Monday to Friday, available 11 AM – 8 PM Eastern. No weekends. It’s not a full day of calls, but you need to be online and ready to call as soon as a quote comes in.

You’re a great fit if you:

Speak clear, natural, confident English and sound warm on the phone.

Respond fast and stay organized.

Have fast internet, a quiet space and a noise-canceling headset.

Have phone sales, appointment setting or scheduling experience (North American local service is a plus).

Pay Structure & Trial:

$25 USD / Day (~$500–$540USD / month) guaranteed base pay.

10% Commission for every cleaning you book.

Example: On a standard $400–$455 deep or move-out clean, you earn your $20 USD daily base plus an extra $40 to $45+ CAD (~$30+ USD) per booking.

1-Week Paid Trial: All new hires start with a 1-week paid trial evaluated strictly on speed-to-lead (calling new quotes within 2–3 minutes) and call quality/objection handling.

How to apply:

Send your resume plus a link to a 30-second audio intro (Google Drive, Vocaroo or Loom). Tell us about your phone sales and scheduling experience and let us hear how you sound. Applications without an audio link won’t be reviewed.

About the Position



We are an established U.S. solar company seeking an experienced B2B appointment setter to help us develop partnerships with roofing companies, contractors, and other home improvement businesses.



Our goal is to introduce these companies to an opportunity to offer solar to their existing customers, creating an additional revenue stream without having to build their own solar operation.

* Make sure prospects understand what will be discussed during their scheduled appointment.

Your job is to generate genuine interest, qualify the prospect, and get the appointment booked.

title: DM setter/ virtual assistant
description:
My name is Peter and I am the cofounder of Fahrenheit Fat Loss. 



About Fahrenheit Fat Loss:



Fahrenheit Fat Loss is a premium online coaching company that helps busy women, especially moms between the ages of 30 and 50, lose 20 to 40 pounds and keep it off for life.



We believe most women don't need another diet. They need a system that fits their real life.



Our coaching combines customized nutrition, strength training, accountability, mindset coaching, and habit change into one simple process that helps women lose weight without giving up their families, careers, or favorite foods.



Our mission is to help women build confidence, regain control of their health, and become the strongest version of themselves, physically and mentally.



Unlike programs that rely on quick fixes or temporary motivation, The Fahrenheit Method is designed to create lasting lifestyle change so our clients only have to lose the weight once.



Our coaching is backed by a results guarantee because we're confident in the system we've built and the support we provide.



Today, Fahrenheit Fat Loss serves women across the United States through a high touch online coaching experience and has helped hundreds of women transform not only their bodies, but their confidence, energy, and quality of life.



We're building a brand that women genuinely trust. Every conversation matters. Every message matters. Every interaction should leave someone feeling understood, challenged, and inspired to become the best version of themselves.



If you're joining our team, you're not just answering DMs or scheduling calls. You're helping change lives.



***I want to be very clear about what I am looking for in a DM setter for Fahrenheit Fat Loss.***



This is not a copy and paste position, a customer service role, or a job where you simply agree with every prospect and make them feel better. Your responsibility is to create real conversations, understand what someone is struggling with, challenge their thinking when necessary, qualify them properly, and confidently move the right people toward booking a call.



You must be available every day from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time. Monday-Saturday. These are the hours when our audience is most active, so reliability and consistency during these shifts are extremely important.



You need to be fluent in written English. Your messages must sound natural, confident, intelligent, and conversational. I do not want robotic responses, awkward wording, generic scripts, or messages that sound like they were copied directly from ChatGPT.



You may use AI to help organize information, review grammar, or improve efficiency, but you cannot depend on it to have conversations for you. You need to know how to think critically, read the tone of a conversation, ask the right follow up question, handle objections, and know when to show empathy versus when someone needs to be challenged.



You will need to study me and the Fahrenheit brand closely. That means watching my content, reading my captions, listening to how I speak, understanding my personality, learning my coaching philosophy, knowing our client success stories, and understanding the women we help.



You should know who I am, what I do, where I live, what I believe in, how I coach, how I communicate, and why prospects choose Fahrenheit. The goal is for someone messaging the account to feel like they are speaking directly with me.



You must have a strong understanding of fitness, nutrition, fat loss, and the mindset required to get results. You should also live a disciplined and healthy lifestyle yourself. I want someone who genuinely represents the standards of the brand.



Your main responsibilities will include:



Responding to incoming Instagram and
 messages quickly.



Starting conversations with new followers and warm leads.



Building rapport without wasting time in endless small talk.



Learning about each prospect’s goals, struggles, urgency, and readiness for coaching.



Qualifying prospects financially and emotionally before booking them.



Moving qualified prospects toward scheduling a sales call.



Following up with leads consistently instead of allowing conversations to disappear.



Confirming appointments and helping improve call attendance.



Keeping accurate notes and updating every lead inside GoHighLevel.



Using Typeform, Instagram,
, Meta Business Suite, Google Sheets, and any other systems required for the position.



Reviewing previous conversations so prospects never have to repeat themselves.



Communicating important information to me clearly and quickly.



You will be expected to book a minimum of 3 qualified calls per week at the beginning. That is the starting standard, not the long term ceiling. As you learn the brand, the offer, and our audience, I expect that number to increase.



A qualified call means the prospect understands what the call is for, has a real problem they want help solving, is open to coaching, has shown some level of commitment, and is not simply booking because they were pressured.



Quality matters just as much as quantity. I do not want a calendar full of people who are unqualified, confused, or unlikely to show up.



The right person for this role is disciplined, organized, competitive, emotionally intelligent, trustworthy, and able to work without being constantly reminded what to do. You should take ownership of your conversations, notice when something is not working, and communicate solutions instead of waiting for instructions.



I am willing to invest time in helping the right person understand the Fahrenheit brand, but I am not looking to teach someone basic communication, work ethic, English, or how to speak with prospects. You should already be proficient in those areas.



I am looking for someone who wants to become a long term part of the company, improve their skills, produce measurable results, and grow as Fahrenheit grows.



Before moving forward, I will want to see examples of how you communicate, how you would respond to different types of prospects, how you handle objections, and how you would move a conversation toward a call without sounding scripted or aggressive.

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Senior AI-First Airbnb Operations VA
description:
Full time, 10-hour shifts, 6 days a week (about 60 hours/week) · Remote, U.S. Eastern hours



ABOUT US

We run 280+ short-term rental units across Philadelphia and Dallas. We lease apartment buildings and operate them as furnished stays, mostly booked through Airbnb. Day-to-day operations run through a remote VA team working with local cleaning and maintenance teams in both cities.



We also build our own operations software, and AI is already part of how we work. We're hiring a senior VA who works the same way.



THE ROLE

You'll handle guest communication and daily operations across our portfolio, using Claude and ChatGPT throughout the day to do it faster and better. You'll also help us build agentic workflows that take repetitive work off the team.



AI drafts, you d
. We need someone who can tell when an AI answer is wrong, when a guest needs a real person, and when to escalate.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

A self-starter who takes initiative and doesn't need to be told what to work on next. You notice gaps in how the business runs and bring a fix, like a guest question that keeps getting answered from scratch or a report someone rebuilds by hand every week. When you see work being done manually, you look for a way to automate it and you're willing to build it yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Guest communication

• Reply to guest messages in Guesty and Airbnb before, during and after each stay. Slow or missed replies are the biggest driver of bad reviews for us, so speed matters.

• Handle check-in and access issues, Wi-Fi, house rules, booking changes, cancellations, and early check-in, late checkout, pet and parking requests.

• Calm down unhappy guests and fix the problem before it becomes a bad review, including refunds within our guidelines.

• Answer questions about our Damage Protection Program and other fees, and apply our waiver policy.

• Ask guests who had a great stay to leave a review.



Reviews and Airbnb

• Track review scores at the unit level and flag units that are slipping.

• Respond to reviews and work with Airbnb Support on removal requests for reviews that break Airbnb policy.

• Handle Resolution Center cases and damage claims.



Operations

• Dispatch and follow up on cleaning and maintenance issues with our local teams until they're closed.

• Keep listings, check-in guides and unit details (door codes, Wi-Fi, instructions) accurate.

• Keep our Notion workspace current: tasks, maintenance tracker, SOPs.

• Pull daily and weekly reports on guest issues, reviews and unit performance.



AI and agentic workflows

• Use Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft guest replies, summarize long threads, analyze review and reservation data in Google Sheets, and write SOPs.

• Build and maintain the knowledge our AI tools work from: property details, house rules, policies, prompt libraries, Claude Projects and custom GPTs.

• Help build and run agentic workflows in Claude and ChatGPT (connectors, MCP, agents) for routine steps like inbox triage, flagging at-risk stays, logging issues to Notion and sending daily reports.

• Spot repetitive work, propose how to automate it, and document what you build so the rest of the team can use it.

• Review AI output before it reaches a guest. Protect guest data and logins, and never paste passwords or API keys into AI tools.



TOOLS WE USE

Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty, our in-house platform, Stripe, PriceLabs, Notion, 
, Google Workspace, Claude, ChatGPT.



You don't need every one on day one. You do need to have worked inside a PMS (Guesty preferred) and be comfortable in Google Sheets and Notion.



MUST HAVE

• 3+ years in short-term rental guest communication or operations, with Airbnb as a main channel

• A self-starter who spots gaps and manual work and fixes or automates them without being asked

• Daily use of Claude and ChatGPT in real work, with examples you can show

• Hands-on experience with at least one agentic or automation setup: Claude Code, Claude with connectors or MCP, custom GPTs with actions, Make or Zapier with AI steps, or an AI agent you've built or run

• Excellent written English that reads warm and natural, not scripted

• Good judgment on when to fix, when to refund and when to escalate

• Comfortable in Google Sheets: filters, formulas, pivot tables

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

• Available full time on U.S. Eastern hours (Philippine night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at Airbnb Support or with a property manager running 100+ units

• PriceLabs or Stripe experience

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks and JSON

• Experience writing SOPs and training other VAs



WHAT WE OFFER

• Full-time, long-term role

• Team bonuses tied to portfolio review scores

• Raises based on performance reviews

• A team that is building AI into every part of its operations



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Your application must include all of the following:



1. Start your message with "AIRBNB AI" so we know you read the full post.

2. Your resume (PDF).

3. A 3 to 5 minute screen-share video (Loom, or unlisted YouTube or Google Drive) walking us through one real AI workflow you use or built in Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool. Show it working and explain what it saves you.

4. Your reply to the guest message below, plus 2 to 3 lines on what you'd do behind the scenes. Use AI the way you normally would, and include the share link to the chat or the prompt you used.

   "Hi, the door code you sent isn't working. We've been outside for 25 minutes with two kids and it's 11pm. If we're not inside in 10 minutes I want a full refund."

5. In 3 to 5 sentences: one agentic workflow you would build in your first 30 days for a 280-unit Airbnb operation, and which tools you'd use.

6. In 3 to 5 sentences: a manual process you noticed in a past role and fixed or automated on your own initiative. What was it, what did you build, and what did it save?

7. A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.

title: Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant
description:
